name: Miley Jab Hum Tum
description: Miley Jab Hum Tum is a youth oriented television series that aired on Indian television channel STAR One, premiering September 22, 2008. The series ran for two years successfully covering two seasons before ending on November 19, 2010. The show is about falling in love during college and developing relations for a lifetime. The show was successful amongst the youth of the country that even after so years following its conclusion, the actors of the show like Rati pandey, Mohit Sehgal, Sanaya Irani, and Arjun Bijlani are still fondly remembered by people.

videos.title: Dia Joins Excel College
videos.overview: Dia joins Excel college and everyone admires her. She likes Samrat, but is upset he ignores her. Later, Samrat talks about the girl of his dreams. Meanwhile,  Gunjan and Nupur decide to leave for Mumbai.

videos.title: Mayank Joins Excel College
videos.overview: Mayank joins Excel college and meets Samrat. Meanwhile, Gunjan and Nupur reach Mumbai. Samrat, Dia and Uday want to welcome Nupur and Gunjan. They plan a party for them. Mayank learns about the party and makes plans.

videos.title: Gunjan Falls Into the Pool
videos.overview: Nupur and Gunjan are not comfortable at the party. Nupur is told to dance but everyone laughs at her. Meanwhile, Gunjan is blindfolded and falls into the swimming pool. Nupur starts screaming and tells everyone that Gunjan doesn’t know how to swim. Will Gunjan survive?

videos.title: Nupur Gets Locked Up
videos.overview: On Nupur and Gunjan’s first day in college, they are subjected to ragging by Uday and Dia, who want them to leave the college. They play a prank on Gunjan when she enters the library. Meanwhile, Nupur is locked in the men’s washroom.

videos.title: Mayank Saves Nupur
videos.overview: Mayank saves Nupur from the men's washroom. Later, Nupur and Gunjan receive punishment from the professors for not paying attention. Mayank and Nupur are expected to work in a project together. Later, Nupur seeks Dia's help to stand out in the college without being ragged.

videos.title: Nupur 'S Fashion Disaster
videos.overview: Nupur becomes a laughing stock at college after Dia dresses her up. Later, she tries to bunk class but gets caught. Meanwhile, As Gunjan answers all the answers in the class, the professor takes her to the principle. She comes across Nupur as well.

videos.title: Gunjan , a Brilliant Student
videos.overview: The principal declares Gunjan as the brilliant student, while he punishes Nupur. Gunjan advises Nupur to concentrate on studies. Later, Mayank helps Gunjan at the library. Diya tries to help Nupur change her talking style. Samrat tries to disturb Gunjan , but she ignores him.

videos.title: Nupur's Naive Nature
videos.overview: Mayank keeps calling out for Nupur regarding the project, leaving Uday miserable as his plans to fool her fails. Everyone at college takes advantage of Nupur for her naive nature. Mayank and Nupur worry about their project. Gunjan and Samrat are paired in a psychology game.

videos.title: Nupur Taunts Mayank
videos.overview: Mayank overhears Nupur taunting him. On his insistence, Nupur takes the responsibility to research for the project. Samrat finds Gunjan in the cafeteria and tries to apologize to her. Later, Gunjan sees Nupur struggling about the project and decides to help her. Dia learns about Uday's party.

videos.title: Dia Insults Samrat
videos.overview: Nupur is annoyed as Mayank instructs her to watch a documentary film related to their project. Samrat calls for Uday, and talks to Gunjan. Dia learns about the party and takes Gunjan with her. Gunjan feels upset as Dia insults Samrat at the pub.

videos.title: Samrat Drops Gunjan Home
videos.overview: Gunjan worries as Dia left her alone at the party. Samrat consoles her and decides to drop her home. Later, Gunjan consoles her as Nupur worries about the project. She prepares Nupur's project. Mayank and Nupur submit their project report.

videos.title: Mayank Is Impressed With Nupur
videos.overview: Mayank is impressed as Nupur submits the project. Nupur thanks Gunjan for her help. Samrat blindfolds himself to sing and apologize to Dia. However, Gunjan takes Dia's place. Mayank apologizes to Nupur for underestimating her. A talent parade competition is announced. Dia plans to insult Gunjan.

videos.title: Auditions for Talent Parade
videos.overview: Nupur is excited for the talent parade competition. Dia informs Nupur about the auditions and asks her to convince Mayank to be her partner. Samrat asks Gunjan to be his partner for the competition.

videos.title: Nupur and Mayank Dance
videos.overview: Samrat irritates Gunjan with his pranks. Meanwhile, Nupur tries her best to convince Mayank. Dia is upset as Mayank agrees to take part the competition with Nupur. Mayank and Nupur perform the dance, leaving everyone stunned.

videos.title: Samrat Requests Gunjan to Sing
videos.overview: Nupur gets delighted when Samrat informs her that she got selected for the competition.  Samrat is surprised to hear Gunjan sing. He requests Gunjan to participate in the competition.  Samrat becomes upset when Gunjan refuses to take part in the competition.

videos.title: Mayank Scolds Nupur
videos.overview: Mayank scolds Nupur for not preparing the project. Nupur decides to participate alone. Samrat convinces Gunjan to participate in the audition. Gunjan is upset as she doesn't get through the auditions. Samrat decides to request Dia to give Gunjan another chance for the auditions.

videos.title: Mayank Loves Nupur
videos.overview: Samrat requests Dia to let Gunjan sing again. Mayank tells Shilpa about his feelings for Nupur. Gunjan prepares Nupur’s notes, which makes her happy. Meanwhile, Samrat tells Nupur to convince Gunjan to give a singing audition. Will Gunjan agree to sing?

videos.title: Miss Aha Listens to Gunjan’s Song
videos.overview: Dia prepares the final list but refuses to add Gunjan’s name to it. Samrat wants Miss Aha to take Gunjan in but she refuses. Later, Miss Aha listens to a recording of Gunjan's song and is bowled over. Mayank and Nupur practice dance for the competition.

videos.title: Gunjan Is Upset With Nupur
videos.overview: Nupur wants to tell the truth to Mayank about the project. Meanwhile, Benji does not understand why Samrat wants Gunjan to sing. Gunjan is annoyed with Nupur but later, they sort out their differences. Nupur feels sad as she misses Morena. Will Mayank comfort her?

videos.title: Samrat in Gunjan's Room
videos.overview: Mayank's mother taunts him about his date with Nupur. Uday helps Samrat, to climb up to Gunjan's room. Gunjan screams as she sees Samrat in the room. Dia and Nupur issist Uday to break open Gunjan's door. Later, Dia notices the ladder and suspects someone in her room. She searches Gunjan's room.

videos.title: Valentine's Day Special
videos.overview: Dia is suspicious when she learns that someone visited Gunjan’s room. However, Uday handles the matter. Samrat and Gunjan celebrate their Valentine's day with each other and when he asks her to sing,she hesitates. Mayank and Nupur discuss about the project over the phone. Later, Dia questions Uday about Samrat's presence outside their house and he lies to her.

videos.title: Mayank Appreciates Nupur
videos.overview: Gunjan prepares Nupur's project. Mayank appreciates Nupur for her efforts and informs her that Shilpa wants to meet her. Samrat succeeds in convincing Gunjan to sing. Later, Mayank and Gunjan meet at the library and later he sees Nupur's project file.

videos.title: Samrat and Nupur Team Up
videos.overview: Mayank asks Gunjan about Nupur's project file. Meanwhile, Samrat tries to learn Gunjan's fear to sing. Later, Mayank taunts Nupur about the project file. Samrat invites Gunjan for the Diwali party and puja. Later, Samrat and Nupur team up to convince Gunjan and Mayank to attend the party.

videos.title: Nupur Meets Mayank's Mother
videos.overview: Nupur and Gunjan decorate their house on the occasion of diwali. They call their father on Diwali and wish him. Later, Nupur goes to Mayank’s house to celebrate Diwali and Gunjan visits Samrat’s house to perform the Diwali rituals.

videos.title: Gunjan Prepares for Diwali
videos.overview: Samrat wants Gunjan to prepare for the Diwali party and asks her to make rangoli. She convinces him to wear traditional clothes. Meanwhile, Mayank’s mother passes a remark at Nupur that upsets her.  Samrat dresses up in a traditional attire and surprises everyone at the party.

videos.title: Nupur Convinces Mayank
videos.overview: Dia is shocked to see Gunjan at Samrat's party. Samrat reminds Dia about their bet over Gunjan. Nupur convinces Mayank to accompany her to Samrat's party. She gets jealous the girls at the party stare at Mayank. Dia insists Gunjan to sing at the Diwali party.

videos.title: Gunjan Agrees to Sing
videos.overview: Gunjan fails to overcome her fear. However, everyone dances at the party. Later, Nupur and Gunjan share their happiness with each other. Uday manages Dia about Samrat's surprise. Gunjan starts feeling for Samrat. Mayank's mother is impressed with Nupur. Gunjan agrees to sing in the competition.

videos.title: Mayank Doubts Nupur
videos.overview: Mayank realises that Nupur’s personality does not match her project report and begins to doubt whether she wrote it. Nupur, on the other hand, is worried about Mayank’s reaction when he comes to know that it was Gunjan who wrote the report.

videos.title: Samrat Buys a Tent!
videos.overview: Mayank questions Nupur and she tells him the report was Gunjan's work. This turns Mayank very angry and he scolds her for lying to him and starts avoiding her. Meanwhile, Samrat buys a tent for Gunjan. What will Gunjan do with the tent?

videos.title: Nupur Is Upset
videos.overview: Mayank is upset with Nupur and scolds her. Dia is very happy that Samrat is planning a surprise for her. However, she learns later that Samrat has no such plans. This makes her furious and she vows to teach a lesson to Samrat and Gunjan.

videos.title: Dia Scolds Uday
videos.overview: Dia is angry at Uday for making her look like a fool. Meanwhile, Nupur is worried that Mayank is not talking to her. Samrat encourages her saying Mayank is planning a surprise for her. Later, Samrat gets his turn to perform in the contest. Who will win?

videos.title: Annie Locks Gunjan in the Room
videos.overview: Mayank and Nupur perform together at the talent parade, where Gunjan agrees to sing. But before she can do so, Annie locks her inside a room. When Gunjan’s performance is announced, Samrat realises that she has not come on stage. Will Gunjan escape from the room?

videos.title: Gunjan Is Missing
videos.overview: Samrat announces Gunjan’s performance, but worries  when she fails to appear on stage. Unknown to him, she is stuck in a storeroom. Will she be able to escape the storeroom and reach the stage on time?

videos.title: Mayank Finds Nupur's Letter
videos.overview: Everyone appreciates Gunjan's performance. Nupur tries to make up with Mayank, but he calls her a liar. Gunjan thanks Samrat for boosting her confidence. Later, she tells Nupur that she suspects Annie. Dia congratulates the sisters. Mayank finds Nupur's letter.

videos.title: Gunjan Learns About Samrat's Bet
videos.overview: Uday overhears Annie and Dia's conversation. Everyone at college congratulate Nupur at college for her performance. The principal announces the exam schedule. Gunjan overhears Samrat and Benji's conversation about the bet over Gunjan. Samrat tries to justify himself.

videos.title: Gunjan Prepares Notes for Samrat
videos.overview: Nupur and Samrat discuss about the exam tension. Samrat goes to the library for Gunjan. Nupur asks Gunjan if anything is wrong. Later, when Mayank passes notes to Nupur, she refuses them, leading to an argument. Meanwhile, Gunjan is annoyed with Samrat for not studying. She gives him notes.

videos.title: Nupur and Mayank Argue
videos.overview: CJ advises Mayank to talk to Nupur directly. Later, Nupur refuses to take Mayank's notes for exam preparation. She challenges to score higher marks than Mayank. They both end up in a heated argument. Later, Samrat tries to tell Gunjan the truth about the bet with Dia.

videos.title: Nupur's Challenge for Mayank
videos.overview: Nupur prays to god to help her with the challenge. Mayank tells his mother about Nupur's challenge. Nupur get caught for sleeping in the class. The professor punishes Nupur to write a chapter 100 times. Samrat's friend tease him for studying. Later, Gunjan promises to help Samrat study.

videos.title: Uday Gifts a Recorder to Nupur
videos.overview: Dia asks Gunjan to help her with the exams. Later, she provokes her to not help Samrat. Uday gifts Nupur a voice recorder, which would help her prepare for exams. Samrat and Dia attend a party, where she mocks him in front of his friends. The next day, Samrat tries to apologize to Gunjan.

videos.title: Samrat's Nightmare
videos.overview: Shukla sir taunts Nupur in the class for not paying attention. Mayank taunts Nupur. Samrat worries about his image. Nupur notices everyone preparing chits for the exam. However, she recalls Mayank's words. Benji tries to fool Uday. Gunjan finds a solution for Samrat's problem.

videos.title: Mayank Taunts Nupur
videos.overview: When Nupur overhears Mayank talking to the librarian about a book, she issues the same book for herself. Gunjan helps Nupur in studying. Later, Samrat reaches the coffee shop late and Gunjan is upset. Mayank taunts Nupur in front of CJ.

videos.title: Nupur Surprises Mayank
videos.overview: Gunjan is upset with Samrat for not revising the notes she prepared for him. Nupur annoys Mayank by issuing the same books as him from the library. Uday requests 2 students to provide him with the question papers. Nupur surprises Mayank when answers the questions in the class.

videos.title: Samrat Tricks Dia
videos.overview: Samrat studies on his date as Benji keeps disturbing Dia. Dia finds the notes when Samrat drops her home. She gets angry and calls Uday and Annie to the cafe as Samrat and Gunjan planned to meet there. Gunjan is shocked to see Samrat arrive early and clarifies his doubts. They are shocked to see Dia

videos.title: Mayank Against Nupur
videos.overview: Nupur is selected for the Inter-college competition. However, Mayank feels that she is not the right choice. Nupur strikes a deal with him. Samrat lies to everyone about a basketball competition in order to skip his examinations. Nupur overhears Samrat and Uday's plan about tricking the principal.

videos.title: Mayank Is Disturbed
videos.overview: Gunjan tells Samrat that the principal is aware of his lies. Uday buys the question papers from his friends. The principal learns that Samrat has lied to him and instructs him to take the test. Meanwhile, Nupur worries about the exam preparations. Mayank is disturbed with Nupur's thoughts.

videos.title: Exam Preparation
videos.overview: Gunjan is ready to help Samrat in the terminal exams. Samrat assures her that he will manage in his exams. Dia gets tensed while preparing for exams. Nupur anyhow manages to prepare for her exams. Samrat finally decides to write his exams by cheating.

videos.title: Samrat Stands Up for Gunjan
videos.overview: Samrat prepares chits for exams. Gunjan boosts confidence to Nupur. Later, Dia taunts Gunjan for worrying about Samrat. During the examination, Benji passes a chit to Samrat, but Gunjan is caught by the professor. However, Samrat stands up for her and blames himself.

videos.title: Gunjan Defends Samrat
videos.overview: Samrat throws a paper to Gunjan warning her about the invigilator, who thinks Gunjan is cheating and sends her to the principal. Samrat follows her and admits it was he who passed the paper. Gunjan defends Samrat and the principal gives another chance to him.

videos.title: Dia Is Jealous of Gunjan
videos.overview: Dia gets jealous of Gunjan's friendship with Samrat. Gunjan requests Nupur to let her visit Samrat's house to help him prepare for the exams. Later, Nupur fumes at Mayank for taking her notes. Later, Mayank's mother praises Nupur for challenging Mayank.

videos.title: Dia Mocks Gunjan
videos.overview: Samrat tells Benji that he decided to reveal the truth to Gunjan about the chits. Dia overhears the conversation and mocks Gunjan . She tells Gunjan about Samrat's bet with her regarding the competition. Nupur and Mayank bump into each other. Later, Samrat is upset as Gunjan cries.

videos.title: Nupur Taunts Mayank
videos.overview: After the exam, Nupur tells Mayank that she will top the college. Professor asks Nupur for a help at the staff room and she learns that she got 91 in hindi exam. Gunjan ignores Samrat. Samrat gets depressed but later requests her to help him with exams.

videos.title: Dia Asks Samrat for a Date
videos.overview: Diya is angry when Gunjan agrees to teach Samrat for exams. Samrat questions Gunjan about the problem. Nupur and Gunjan prepare for their last exam. Samrat asks Gunjan on a date after the exams. Nupur is happy as the exams have finished. Samrat gets annoyed when Dia asks him to take her out.

videos.title: Gunjan Shocks Samrat
videos.overview: Samrat gets upset when Gunjan refuses to go on a date with him. Nupur and Samrat were called to the Prof Dheodhar's office. Gunjan reminds Samrat about his bet with Dia, leaving him shocked. Prof Dheodhar informs Nupur and Samrat about being selected for the inter-college competition.

videos.title: Mayank Consoles Gunjan
videos.overview: Mayank consoles Gunjan for being upset. Nupur questions Gunjan about why she is upset. Dia informs Samrat that she told Gunjan about the bet. She pretends to console him as a good friend. CJ refuses to be Mayank's partner for the competition. Later, Nupur scolds Samrat for troubling Gunjan.

videos.title: Benji Helps Samrat
videos.overview: Benji helps Samrat in his plans to impress Gunjan. Nupur learns about Samrat's bet and is furious. Dia invites Mayank to her New Year's party. Mayank decides to attend the party to taunt Nupur. Dia tells Gunjan that Samrat is invited for the party. Nupur consoles Gunjan.

videos.title: Dia's Boyfriend, Guru
videos.overview: At the party, Uday tries to impress the girls. Dia mocks Samrat. Mayank and Nupur argue about wearing the same color dress for the party. Dia's boyfriend, Guru surprises everyone at the party. Benji keeps an eye on Gunjan. Meanwhile, Samrat arrives at the party.

videos.title: Samrat Sings at the Party
videos.overview: Benji informs all the news to Samrat over the phone. Guru becomes a laughing stock as he falls off while dancing. Dia is embarrassed. Gunjan gets upset when Benji talks about Samrat. Ishika requests Nupur to introduce Mayank to her and she agrees . Gunjan leaves the party as Samrat sings.

videos.title: Mayank's New Partner, Ishika
videos.overview: Samrat gets upset when Gunjan calls him Selfish. Nupur tells Ishika to talk about Economics, to impress Mayank. Ishika agrees to be his debate partner for the competition. She asks Mayank to meet her at a spa as per Nupur's plan. Uday tries to impress a girl, but fails. Samrat asks Benji for help.

videos.title: Samrat's Plan to Apologize
videos.overview: Benji turns the lights off at the party for Samrat to apologize to Gunjan. However, Samrat apologizes to Nupur in the dark. As the clock ticks to 12, everyone wishes happy new year to each other. Meanwhile, Uday kisses Benji in the dark. Nupur tries to convince Gunjan about Samrat.

videos.title: Nupur Consoles Samrat
videos.overview: Gunjan doesn't listen to Nupur's advise about Samrat. Benji feels disgusted for Uday's kiss. Gunjan and Samrat are lost in each others thoughts. Gunjan requests Samrat to stay away from her. Later, Nupur tries to console Samrat at college. Samrat apologizes to Gunjan at the college canteen.

videos.title: Nupur to Unite Samrat, Gunjan
videos.overview: Mayank wants to convince Ishika and Dia wants to make Samrat jealous. Meanwhile, Nupur promises Samrat to reconcile the differences between Gunjan and Samrat. Later, Nupur finds Mayank in the ladies' parlour. What will she do?

videos.title: Nupur and Mayank Fight
videos.overview: When Mayank goes to the ladies parlour by mistake, his mother sees him there. Nupur and Mayank start fighting in front of everyone. Later, Nupur tells Gunjan that she should forgive Samrat. Will Gunjan reconcile her differences with Samrat?

videos.title: Mayank Accuses Nupur
videos.overview: Benji asks Samrat about the reason for his happiness. CJ informs Mayank that the college results are leaked. The college students congratulate Gunjan Prof Dheodhar tells Mayank and Nupur to represent excel college for the academic meet. Mayank accuses Nupur for embarrassing him.

videos.title: Mayank and Nupur Prepare to Leave
videos.overview: Uday shares his dream about CJ with Benji and Samrat. Mayank promises to make the trip memorable for Nupur and Samrat assures her he will take care of Gunjan. Later, Prof Shukla and the principal inform Gunjan that she has been selected for the RJ hunt. Samrat wants to speak to Gunjan. Will Gunjan talk to him?

videos.title: Chironju Irritates Nupur- Mayank
videos.overview: Nupur bumps into Chironji and he irritates her. Mayank taunts Nupur in the bus. They travel together to Ahmedabad. Gunjan get nervous when she sees other participants at the RJ hunt auditions. She meets Purab there. Later, Chironji exchanges places with Nupur and irritates Mayank in the bus.

videos.title: Nupur's Misses Her Bus
videos.overview: Mayank scares Nupur in the bus. Later, Nupur and Chironji irritate Mayank. The bus halts for lunch, and Nupur gets engrossed in reading a magazine at the shop. Samrat tries to convince Gunjan to forgive him. She left behind, as the bus leaves. However, Mayank gets off the bus too.

videos.title: Samrat and Purab Meet
videos.overview: Gunjan worries about the RJ hunt competition and misses Nupur. Mayank and Nupur walk through the jungle. Diya discusses about organizing a Valentine ball for the college students. Dia pretends to be a good friend with Samrat. Samrat learns from Purab about competing against Gunjan. Nupur finds Mayank.

videos.title: Mayank Collects the Wood
videos.overview: Gunjan prepares herself for the RJ hunt competition. Samrat makes Benji change his voice to call Gunjan. They try to boost her confidence. Mayank gets fed up with Nupur in the jungle. CJ ridicules Uday when he tries talking to her. Mayank collects wood for campfire and argues with Nupur.

videos.title: Uday Asks CJ for the Ball
videos.overview: Mayank uses Nupur's magazine to lit fire to the food , leaving her angry. Uday asks CJ to accompany him to the Valentines ball in front of everyone. Mayank finds a papaya and shares it with Nupur. Gunjan talks to the basketball given by Samrat. Mayank and Nupur fight for water bottle.

videos.title: Dia Announces a Twist
videos.overview: Mayank and Nupur are struck in the jungle. Purab and Samrat discuss about Rj hunt auditions. Mayank tries to get even with Nupur and disturbs her sleep. Dia announces a twist for the valentines ball. Benji promises to help Uday. Nupur and Mayank find a road out of the jungle. Nupur taunts Mayank.

videos.title: Purab Boosts Gunjan's Confidence
videos.overview: Mayank gets negative vibes about the lodge. Aparajita makes Gunjan nervous but Purab boosts her confidence. Samrat appreciates Dia for her efforts. Later, Nupur understands the Lodge's true nature. Benji informs Samrat that Gunjan read the card sent by him. Mayank and Nupur share a moment.

videos.title: RJ Hunt Auditions Begin
videos.overview: The Rj hunt auditions begin. Aparijita and Purab give their individual speeches. Nupur scolds the Lodge owner for not waking them up on time. She and Mayank try to ask people for lift on the highway. Later, Purab assures Gunjan to give her best. Samrat looks at Gunjan giving her speech.

videos.title: Gunjan Wins First Place
videos.overview: Nupur and Mayank take shelter at a village. Gunjan wins the first round of the audition. The principal announces about the 2nd round of Live radio show. Uday takes CJ on a date. Aparajita taunts Gunjan. However, Purab snubs her and supports Gunjan. Nupur and Mayank argue over an alcohol bottle.

videos.title: Nupur Gets Drunk
videos.overview: Samrat gifts a phone to Gunjan. Uday impresses Cj at the dinner date. Samrat makes Benji call Gunjan to ask her to accept the phone. Gunjan refuses to accept the gift until he meets her as wants to know the admirer. Nupur gets drunk and dances in the restaurant.

videos.title: Nupur Asks Mayank to Marry Her
videos.overview: Nupur and Mayank take shelter in a hut. Gunjan recalls the moments spent wit Samrat and talks to the basketball. Dia orders everyone to decorate the college. Nupur misunderstands the situation and asks Mayank to marry her. Principal asks Dia to select a song for Nupur to dance.

videos.title: Samrat to Teach Gunjan
videos.overview: Mayank and Nupur are stuck in the hut and end up fighting. Meanwhile, the principal tells Gunjan that she has to perform a dance on Valentine's Day. Samrat teaches her and asks for her forgiveness. Will Gunjan forgive him?

videos.title: Samrat Teaches Dance to Gunjan
videos.overview: Samrat teaches dance to Gunjan and assures to be her dance teacher. Meanwhile, Nupur and Mayank fake their relationship to get a lift from a stranger. Samrat reminds Gunjan about her promise made to the principal.

videos.title: Samrat Dances With Dia
videos.overview: Samrat tries to boost up self confidence for Gunjan. Uday gifts a bouquet to Benji, leaving him shocked. Dia feels jealous to see Samrat and Gunjan together. She mocks Gunjan for her dance. Samrat dances with Dia to show it to Gunjan.

videos.title: Gunjan to Meet Her Secret Admirer
videos.overview: Gunjan wishes to meet her secret admirer. Meanwhile, Chunky locks Nupur and Mayur in his house to spend the valentines night. Benji calls Gunjan and she requests him to meet her. Nupur and Mayank fight with each other at Chunky's house. Uday is upset as he doesnt have a partner for the dance.

videos.title: Samrat Gives a Rose to Gunjan
videos.overview: Dia doesn't let any girl wish Samrat on Valentines day. Nupur and Mayank fight while preparing food. Gunjan accepts Samrat's rose. Mayank is flattered by Nupur's beauty and they both decide to stay as good friends. Gunjan waits for her secret admirer at the ball.

videos.title: Gunjan Waits for the Admirer
videos.overview: Nupur disturbs Mayank. Mayank's thoughts are filled with Nupur and he worries for developing feelings for her. Uday waits for CJ for the dance, While Gunjan eagerly waits for her secret admirer. A random girl knocks Chunky's house door and requests for help as a mob chases her.

videos.title: Nupur Acts as Mayank's Wife
videos.overview: Mayank and Nupur want to send the mob away. They tell the mob that they are husband and wife. The mob believes them and goes away. Purab introduces Vidushi to Gunjan. Meanwhile, Diya plans a game on Valentine’s day. She wishes Samrat to be her partner. Who will Samrat choose as his partner?

videos.title: Samrat Wants Gunjan to Win
videos.overview: Mayank and Nupur share intense feelings for each other. Priyanka tells them that they are the best couple. Later, there is a challenge to see who can eat the most number of chillies. Samrat wants Gunjan to win so he tries to eat more chillies than Nupur. Will Gunjan and Samrat win the game?

videos.title: Gunjan Suspects Purab
videos.overview: Mayank and Nupur tell each other about the kind of partner they want. Vidhushi tells Gunjan that Samrat is her good friend and that is why he ate so many chillies for her. Later, Gunjan thinks that Purab is her special friend, but she is wrong. Who is her special friend?

videos.title: Gunjan Feels Happy
videos.overview: Gunjan feels happy to see Samrat’s care for her. But Samrat is upset that he cannot express his feelings to Gunjan. Meanwhile, Mayank tells Nupur that they should not miss the next day’s bus. Later, Benji cannot find Samrat and Gunjan in the party. Where are they?

videos.title: Gunjan Apologises to Samrat
videos.overview: Samrat and Gunjan become the best couple on Valentine’s Day. Meanwhile, CJ tells Uday that she treats him only as a friend. Samrat buys a bike and takes Gunjan on a ride. This turns Dia jealous. Later, Gunjan apologises to Samrat. What will Samrat tell her?

videos.title: Gunjan Appreciates Samrat
videos.overview: Samrat and Gunjan clear their misunderstandings. Samrat tells Gunjan that he treats her as a very special friend. Gunjan appreciates Samrat for making this Valentine's day special for her. Meanwhile, Mayank and Nupur recall their fights. Will Mayank accept the fact that he loves Nupur?

videos.title: Nupur and Mayank Go to Ahmedabad
videos.overview: Diya taunts Gunjan for her incapability to compete with her in any competition. Nupur is happy on patching up with Samrat. Meanwhile, Purab briefs Gunjan for the contest. Mayank and Nupur meet Chunky Mishra and get upset. Chunky offers to drop them to Ahmedabad. Will they go with him?

videos.title: Samrat, Gunjan's Movie Date
videos.overview: Gunjan decides to participate in the Radio jockey show and starts preparing for it. She goes with Samrat for a movie and talks about the show. Nupur and Mayank reach Ahmedabad. Nupur tells Mayank to buy some clothes for her. However, they are late for the competition. Will they be able to win?

videos.title: Gunjan Is Surprised to See Samrat
videos.overview: Gunjan is surprised to see Samrat on the show. He gives her CDs of old film songs and helps her to make the show a hit. Meanwhile, Nupur cannot interpret the action taken by Mayank in the competition. They lose the round. Will they be able to win the competition?

videos.title: Gunjan Dreams About Samrat
videos.overview: Mayank ignores Nupur so that he does not fall in love with her. Nupur finds Mayank’s behaviour strange and wonders why he is behaving like this. Meanwhile, Gunjan has a dream about Samrat. Later, Nupur gives Chiruji a treat that makes Mayank jealous. What is the treat for?

videos.title: Aparajita Makes Fun of Gunjan
videos.overview: Gunjan tells Nupur about her show. Diya and Uday give their best wishes to Gunjan. Samrat also encourages her for the show. But Aparajita makes fun of Gunjan’s costume. Later, Chiruji plans to impress Nupur and laughs at Mayank, angering him. Will Mayank take revenge on Chiruji?

videos.title: Mayank Protects Nupur From Goons
videos.overview: Nupur is angry at Mayank for being rude with Chiruji. Later, Mayank saves Nupur from some goons, who misbehave with her. Nupur is injured and Mayank takes her to the hospital. Meanwhile, Gunjan’s show is about to start but she cannot find her CDs. Where are they?

videos.title: Mayank Falls for Nupur
videos.overview: Nupur asks Mayank why he is worried. Mayank feels love for Nupur. Gunjan is tense about her show as she does not have her CDs. She decides to call Samrat and tells him about it. She asks for his help. Samrat promises to help her. What will Samrat do?

videos.title: Samrat Tells Gunjan to Sing
videos.overview: Samrat tells Gunjan to sing on her radio show. Nupur and Mayank appear for the quiz competition. Mayank answers all the questions and they go to the next level. Nupur is very happy about the theme of the round. What is the round about? Will they win?

videos.title: Nupur and Mayank Win
videos.overview: Samrat plans to ruin Aparajita’s show. Uday calls on her show and teases her. Mayank and Nupur give an excellent performance in the competition and win it. Later, Nupur meets a fortune teller, who tells her the name of her love. What name does the fortune teller take?

videos.title: Nupur Dreams About Her Love Life
videos.overview: Samrat ruins Aparajita’s show by calling her. She is nervous and disconnects the call. However, Gunjan finds out that it was Samrat who called Aparajita. She thanks him for helping her out. Meanwhile, Nupur dreams about her love life. Whom does she see in her dream?

videos.title: Nupur Shares With Mayank
videos.overview: Nupur tells Mayank about her dream house. They get into an argument and Mayank tells her not to talk such nonsense. Meanwhile, Gunjan is declared the winner of the radio show. Samrat wants to celebrate Holi. Gunjan finds out about the rules of Holi from Diya. What are the rules?

videos.title: Mayank and Nupur Argue Again
videos.overview: Nupur and Mayank argue. Samrat informs Gunjan about Holi celebrations. Later, Nupur and Gunjan are happy to see each other. Nupur finds out about Gunjan’s radio show. Mayank sees Nupur’s letter and learns the truth about her project. What is the truth?

videos.title: Mayank Drinks Bhang
videos.overview: Nupur searches for Gunjan as she wants to apply colours on her. Diya is not happy with the arrangements. She gets angry when Samrat throws colours at her. Mayank wants to express his feelings to Nupur and drinks bhang to make things easy for him. Will he confess his love to Nupur?

videos.title: Uday and Mayank Get Drunk at Holi
videos.overview: Uday gets drunk during Holi celebrations and Benji sends him to the women's rest room on purpose. Mayank too gets drunk and insists on Nupur dropping him home. Mayank's mother is stunned to see an intoxicated Mayank. Later, Nupur and Mayank's mother talk. What do they discuss?

videos.title: Samrat Is on Gunjan's Mind
videos.overview: Nupur notices that Gunjan is happy and going on talking about Samrat. The next morning, Mayank wakes up with a hangover and his mother teases him about Nupur. Later, Uday looks for the new student in college. Meanwhile, Gunjan asks Nupur about love. What does Nupur explain to Gunjan?

videos.title: Uday Gives Tamanna a Bouquet
videos.overview: Samrat fools Uday by telling him that rose day falls on fools day. Uday searches for his true love and Gunjan is surprised with his behaviour. Samrat tells Mayank about his feelings, but Mayank scolds him. Uday sees Tamanna and gives her a bouquet. Will Uday be reprimanded? What did Samrat tell Mayank?

videos.title: Samrat Gives Gunjan a Bouquet
videos.overview: Everyone is surprised to see Mayank in the canteen. Meanwhile, Samrat gifts a bouquet to Gunjan. Later, Samrat sees Gunjan in the college campus late in the night and asks her the reason. Did Gunjan accept Samrat's bouquet? What is Gunjan doing in college so late?

videos.title: Mayank Waits for His Mother
videos.overview: Mayank is disturbed and tells CJ that he will try to go back to how he was. Later, Uday comes into Gunjan's room. Meanwhile, Mayank meets his mother and tells her something that moves her. Much later, Gunjan contemplates calling Samrat. Why did Uday enter Gunjan's room? What did Mayank tell his mother?

videos.title: Nupur Supports Samrat
videos.overview: The unknown biker returns, and tries to get into a fight with Samrat. Later, Samrat rides away leaving Benji alone. He lands up at Gunjan and Nupur's room with ice cream. Nupur says that Samrat cares about Gunjan. What happened to the unknown biker? What does Gunjan feel about Samrat's gesture?

videos.title: Ranvijay Kisses Diya
videos.overview: Gunjan hears Diya say that a guy offers a red rose to a girl out of love. This makes Gunjan believe that Samrat loves her. She buys something that she thinks Samrat would like. Later, after the Principal introduces Ranvijay to everyone, Ranvijay kisses Diya. How did Diya react? What did Gunjan buy?

videos.title: Nupur Tries to Talk to Mayank
videos.overview: Nupur's attempts to talk to Mayank bear no fruit. She tries to call him, but he doesn't pick her call. However, his mother picks up and invites her home. Meanwhile, Gunjan wishes to give Samrat's gift soon, while, Samrat gets her red roses. Who will he gift it to? Will Mayank speak to Nupur?

videos.title: Samrat and Ranvijay Almost Fight
videos.overview: Nupur gives Mayank a bunch of roses. Even Mayank's mom forces him to accept them. Meanwhile, Samrat disappoints Gunjan by telling her that he will not pick her up for college as he is busy. Later, Diya intervenes and stops an altercation between Samrat and Ranvijay. Will Mayank accept Nupur's roses?

videos.title: Ranvijay Gets Offended?
videos.overview: Samrat talks to Mayank about Nupur, but Mayank doesn't listen. Meanwhile, Diya tells Ranvijay that Samrat is the real cool dude of the college. Separately, Gunjan keeps looking for Samrat.  Will Ranvijay get offended by Diya's statement? Will Gunjan find Samrat?

videos.title: Samrat Showers Flowers on Gunjan
videos.overview: Mayank feels that Nupur doesn't understand the meaning of giving red roses. Meanwhile, Samrat keeps giving surprises to Gunjan. Finally, Samrat showers different coloured flower petals on Gunjan and compares their friendship to those. What is Gunjan's reaction? Will Mayank understand Nupur's feelings?

videos.title: Samrat's Behaviour Hurts Gunjan
videos.overview: Tamanna accepts a red rose given by Uday. He feels elated and begins to fantasise about her. Meanwhile, Gunjan feels dejected as she believes that Samrat only thinks of her as a friend. Later, she accidentally drops the gift given by Samrat. Will Samrat think that Gunjan is angry with him?

videos.title: Ranvijay Faces a Tense Moment
videos.overview: Ranvijay and Samrat share a tense moment in the canteen. Meanwhile, Nupur visits Mayank, but it appears to irritate him. Later, a depressed Gunjan still grapples with her feelings for Samrat and decides to just be a friend to him. Will Samrat realise the cause of her behaviour?

videos.title: Mayank Tells the Truth
videos.overview: Mayank tells his mother the reason he is rude to Nupur. Meanwhile, Ranvijay tells Diya to stay away from Samrat. Later, Samrat asks Gunjan to join him for a cup of coffee. Gunjan initially declines, but agrees later. What will Samrat tell Gunjan?

videos.title: Basket Ball Hits on Mayank
videos.overview: Tamanna announces that drama will be included as extra curricular activity. While the basket ball hits on mayank. Ranvijay wants to be cast as hero and Diya as the heroine, Samrat wants the same for himself and Gunjan. Meanwhile, Sheena enters the assembly hall and everyone stares at her.

videos.title: Gunjan Tends to Samrat
videos.overview: Principal asks Samrat to help Sheena. Nupur wants Mayank to participate in the auditions, but he refuses. Gunjan senses some chemistry between Samrat with Sheena and feels bad. Later, Samrat promises Nupur that he will get Mayank to take part in the auditions.

videos.title: Shilpa Selects Nupur
videos.overview: Shilpa tells Nupur that she is the right girl for Mayank. Later, Nupur points out to Samrat that by paying attention to Sheena, he is ignoring Gunjan. Taken aback, Samrat forces Gunjan to come for the auditions. Meanwhile, Tamanna forces Mayank to enter the audition room. Will Mayank audition?

videos.title: Samrat Partners With Sheena
videos.overview: Samrat chooses Sheena as his partner after Gunjan refuses. This irritates Diya who then chooses Ranvijay. Tamanna informs the participants that they would have to ad lib their performance. Mayank is finally convinced and he partners with Nupur. How do the performances go?

videos.title: Mayank Warns Shilpa
videos.overview: Mayank asks his mother to stay away from Nupur. Meanwhile, when Sheena's car gets a flat tyre, Samrat offers her a lift to college. Later, Samrat and Ranvijay have a race and Samrat wins. Afterwards, Samrat offers to pick Sheena up the next day as well. Is Samrat developing feelings for Sheena?

videos.title: Mayank and Nupur Get Selected
videos.overview: Tamanna announces that Nupur and Mayank have been selected as the first couple. She adds that Samrat and Ranvijay have to undergo another audition to partner with Sheena. Meanwhile, Mayank wants to get out of the drama. An irate Nupur asks him what his problem is. What does Mayank tell her?

videos.title: Nupur Stops Talking to Mayank
videos.overview: Nupur tells Mayank that she will never talk to him again. Mayank withdraws from the play. Later, Uday promises Tamanna that he will get Mayank back into the play. Meanwhile, Ranvijay uses his own lines during his act with Sheena. Will Mayank realise Nupur's importance now?

videos.title: Gunjan Feels Inferior
videos.overview: While everyone appreciates Samrat's performance, Mayank deems the drama a waste of time. Meanwhile, upset with Samrat, Gunjan develops an inferiority complex. She begins to fall into depression. Later, when Nupur finds out about Gunjan's situation, she decides to do something about it.

videos.title: Gunjan and Nupur Argue
videos.overview: Gunjan and Nupur argue. Uday and Tamanna try their best to convince Mayank to take part in the play. Meanwhile, Samrat asks Sheena out for coffee. Later, Ranvijay meets Diya and tells her that his life is going to change. What is Ranvijay referring to?

videos.title: Nupur Decides to Tell the Truth
videos.overview: Tamanna thanks Uday for convincing Mayank to participate in the drama. Meanwhile, Ranvijay and Samrat get into another argument. This time, Diya takes Ranvijay's side. Later, Nupur decides to tell Samrat how much Gunjan loves him. Will Gunjan stop her from disclosing this?

videos.title: Gunjan Refuses Samrat's Help
videos.overview: Mayank shocks everyone by acting like Samrat. This leads Nupur to wonder if Mayank is on drugs. Meanwhile, Samrat offers to drop Gunjan, but she refuses. Later, he picks Sheena up and takes her to a roadside coffee shop. Her behaviour at the shop comes across as strange. What does she do?

videos.title: Nupur Thinks Mayank Is on Drugs
videos.overview: Tamanna gives everyone the details of their respective roles and lines. Everyone practice their lines. Meanwhile, Benji tells Gunjan that he does not like the way Samrat behaves with Sheena. Later, Mayank and Nupur talk and she begins to believe that Mayank is on drugs. Is he?

videos.title: Diya Thinks About Samrat
videos.overview: Tamanna swaps the partners around to form odd teams. While Diya thinks about Samrat, Nupur thinks about Mayank. Meanwhile, Ranvijay tricks Nupur into believing that Mayank really is on drugs. Later, Samrat meets Gunjan and discloses something shocking to her.

videos.title: Mayank Makes Nupur Cry
videos.overview: Samrat asks Gunjan the reason for the change in her behaviour. Uday walks Tamanna to her car and they find out that the car does not start. Meanwhile, Mayank learns that Nupur suspects him of doing drugs. He berates her for thinking so. Nupur cries and leaves. Will Mayank regret his actions?

videos.title: Mayank Regrets Hurting Nupur
videos.overview: Mayank regrets hurting Nupur and wants to apologise to her. Meanwhile, Sheena declines Samrat's offer to drop her. Later, Samrat taunts Ranvijay over being able to shoot down bottles with a gun. Mayank's mother comes by and advises him. What does she tell him?

videos.title: Nupur Declines Mayank's Apology
videos.overview: Gunjan pretends to be fine with her situation with Samrat. Later, Mayank apologises to Nupur, but she refuses to accept his apology. She also decides not to be his partner. However, Tamanna asks them to be professional and forces them to do a scene together. Will Nupur's anger ruin the scene?

videos.title: Tamanna Asks Mayank to Express
videos.overview: Samrat asks Sheena out and she agress. Meanwhile, Tamanna asks Mayank use drama to express his emotions. Mayank does his part very well. This surprises Nupur and impresses Tamanna. Later, Mayank asks Nupur to embrace him. Does she agree?

videos.title: Mayank to Impress Nupur
videos.overview: Mayank wants Nupur to forgive him and tries using dialogues from movie Tezaab to convince Nupur.  Meanwhile, much to Gunjan's surprise, Sheena pays Gunjan a compliment. Later, Mayank tells Nupur that his life is empty without her. What does Nupur tell him?

videos.title: Mayank Day Dreams
videos.overview: Gunjan questions Mayank for day dreaming. Ranvijay forces Dia to agree to go on a date. Samrat expresses his feelings for Sheena to Gunjan. Mayank visits nupur's house to practice for the rehearsal. Samrat and Gunjan cook dinner for Sheena. He thanks her for her help and ruses to get ready.

videos.title: Samrat Seeks Gunjan's Help
videos.overview: Gunjan selects a shirt for Samrat for his date. Nupur tells Mayank that she is in love with Sharukh khan. Uday meets Tamanna's grandmother and finds it difficult to talk to her. Mayank and Nupur continue to rehearse for the play. Gunjan burns her hand by mistake while talking to Samrat.

videos.title: Nupur Dress Tears
videos.overview: Mayank gives his shirt to Nupur as her dress tears. Samrat applies ointment to Gunjan's burnt hand. As Sheena arrives, Gunjan leaves the place. Mayank prepares coffee for Nupur as it gets cold. Uday saves Tamana's grandmother as she cokes while eating.

videos.title: Nupur Thanks Mayank
videos.overview: Nupur thanks Mayank for the coffee. Sheena's praises Samrat for his clean room. Ranvijay takes Dia to a pub and she refuses to drink. Samrat tells the truth to Sheena, and she appreciates Gunjan and Samrat's friendship. Mayank and Nupur are lost in each others thoughts.

videos.title: Sheena Is Jealous of Gunjan
videos.overview: Sheena gets jealous of Gunjan when Samrat talks about her. Nupur asks Gunjan about her feelings for Samrat. Mayank assures himself about his feelings for Nupur. Samrat advises dia to be careful with Ranvijay. Mayank gives red roses to Nupur.

videos.title: Mayank Lost in Nupur's Thoughts
videos.overview: Uday mistakes Tamanna's rehearsal dialogues for her feelings. Nupur and Mayank are lost in each others thoughts. Samrat tries to make Dia understand about Ranvijay's character, but she refuses to. Sheena is jealous to see Samrat and Gunjan engrossed in a deep conversation.

videos.title: Ranvijay Provokes Samrat
videos.overview: Ranvijay's friends threaten Samrat for his behaviour. They both pick on a fight. Ranvjjay provokes Samrat by talking ill of Gunjan. Gunjan tells Mayank about Samrat and Ranvijay's fight. Will their fight continue?

videos.title: Ranvijay Gets Slapped
videos.overview: Principal saxena stops the fights, and Samrat is rused to the hospital in Sheena's car. Gunjan cries and requests Samrat to not fight with Ranvijay again. Later, Principal asks Ranvijay to wait outside his office. Dia slaps Ranvijay for everything.

videos.title: Ranvijay Gets a Warning
videos.overview: The Principal gives another chance to Ranvijay for his actions. Later, Nupur appreciates Mayank for saving Mayank. Sheena questions Gunjan about her friendship with Samrat. Later, she hugs Samrat and asks him to be with her. Mayank asks Nupur the reason for being emotional when he is hurt

videos.title: Gunjan Clears Off Sheena's Doubts
videos.overview: Gunjan clears off Sheena's doubts. Mayank's mother is happy that he and Nupur are in talking terms. Diya forgives Ranvijay and decides to stay as friends for a big drama. Nupur rehearses lines for the play at college. Ranvijay decides to take revenge on Samrat and Diya.

videos.title: Mayank Shares His Feelings
videos.overview: Samrat awaits Gunjan's call, and is a tad disappointed when Sheena calls him. Later, much to his surprise and Diya's delight, Ranvijay apologises to Samrat. Meanwhile, Mayank and Nupur grapple with their feelings for each other, but struggle to reveal it.

videos.title: Lead Pairs Asked to Propose
videos.overview: Benji motivates Uday to express his feelings to Tamanna. Meanwhile, Mayank asks Samrat to help him figure out what is going through Nupur's mind. Later, Tamanna announces that the lead pairs will have to propose to each other for the rehearsals. Mayank gets excited with the idea.

videos.title: Mayank Proposes to Nupur
videos.overview: In character, Mayank proposes to Nupur and lets loose a barrage of romantic statements. Nupur initially refuses to accept, but when Mayank asks her to look into his eyes, Nupur goes weak in the knees. She forgets her lines, but corrects herself. Finally, she gives her answer.

videos.title: Nupur Is Appreciated
videos.overview: Everyone appreciate Nupur's performance. Soon, Samrat and Sheena take the stage. While Samrat says his lines, Sheena fumbles and makes several mistakes. Later, Mayank asks Nupur why she said yes when her dialogue was no. What does Nupur tell Mayank?

videos.title: Mayank Reveals His Feelings
videos.overview: Mayank reveals to Nupur that she is the only one for him. Meanwhile, Tamanna asks Gunjan to rehearse with Samrat to help Sheena. Gunjan speaks from her heart. Later, she tells herself that she needs to stay away from Samrat and Sheena. Someone overhears her.

videos.title: Ranvijay Conspires Against Diya
videos.overview: Diya visits Ranvijay’s house for rehearsals. However, Ranvijay plots to add drugs in Diya’s juice. Meanwhile, Gunjan starts to sing the song for the play and everyone joins her. Later, she compliments Samrat for his performance. She also asks him to spend time with Sheena.

videos.title: Sheena Questions Uday
videos.overview: Uday tells Sheena that Gunjan and Samrat are made for each other. Meanwhile, Rannvijay tries to spike the juice that he offers to Diya. Later, Uday tells Nupur that Mayank does not suit her. Nupur comes to a conclusion that she is not compatible with Mayank and makes up her mind to forget him.

videos.title: Samrat Is Being Avoided
videos.overview: Sheena insists on Gunjan staying out of the play. Meanwhile, Samrat wonders why Gunjan is avoiding him. Gunjan wants Samrat not to think about her. Later, during rehearsals, Tamanna scolds Nupur for making mistakes. Nupur then makes another deduction about herself.

videos.title: Samrat Shares His Feelings
videos.overview: Samrat tells Sheena that sometimes he dreams of being in a relationship with Gunjan. He adds that Gunjan would surely reject him if he ever proposes. Later, Diya goes to Rannvijay’s room. One of his friends there tries to misbehave with Diya. Rannvijay slaps his friend. Is his anger for real?

videos.title: Mayank Rescues Nupur
videos.overview: Locked in the library, Nupur finally calls Mayank, who rushes to get her out. Meanwhile, Gunjan helps Samrat buy a gift for Sheena. He buys her a gift for helping him. Gunjan is shocked to see Samrats gift. What is the reason behind Gunjan's reaction?

videos.title: Sheena Sees Samrat's Gifts
videos.overview: Mayank wonders if Nupur loves him or the character he plays during rehearsal. He decides to stop forcing his feelings on Nupur and wait for her to reciprocate. Meanwhile, Sheena sees Samrat's gifts and feels Gunjan had something to do with them. Will Sheena realise that Samrat loves Gunjan?

videos.title: Samrat Proposes Sheena
videos.overview: Diya refuses to take an expensive gift from Rannvijay. Meanwhile, confused about the duality that Mayank displays, Nupur stays away from him. Later, Samrat asks Sheena if she is ready for a relationship. Sheena puts forth a shocking condition before she can commit to Samrat.

videos.title: Samrat Cannot Give Up Gunjan
videos.overview: Taken aback by Sheena's condition, Samrat tells her that he cannot give up his friendship with Gunjan. Later, Gunjan sees Samrat and asks him why he looks so upset after his date. Samrat contemplates telling Gunjan about Sheena's condition, but then decides not to. However, Gunjan finds out. How?

videos.title: Sheena Is Appreciated
videos.overview: Nupur finds Mayank shirtless in the dressing room. He catches Nupur looking at him and both get flustered. They wonder how to face each other during rehearsal. Meanwhile, Tamanna appreciates Sheena's performance. In response, she makes a sarcastic statement. What does Sheena say?

videos.title: Samrat Decides to Talk to Gunjan
videos.overview: Sheena tells Gunjan not to worry about Samrat, as she would take special care of him. Meanwhile, Tamanna asks Mayank to find out if Nupur has taken her costumes with her. Mayank wonders if calling her will fluster her even more. Later, Samrat makes a decision regarding Gunjan.

videos.title: Sheena Calls Gunjan a Problem
videos.overview: Sheena accuses Gunjan of being a problem between her and Samrat. Shocked, Gunjan asks Nupur for advice. Nupur tells her that a boy should be ready to sacrifice anything for his one true love. Meanwhile, Rannvijay plans to use Gunjan and Sheena to ruin Samrat's life.

videos.title: Samrat Chooses Gunjan
videos.overview: While Samrat decides not to break his friendship with Gunjan, she decides to stay away from him. Meanwhile, Nupur is sad that the drama is coming to an end. Later, Rannvijay starts planting doubts about Samrat's character in Sheena's mind. However, Sheena tells him off. What does she say?

videos.title: Samrat Gives Gunjan a Rose
videos.overview: Gunjan is shocked when Samrat gives her a rose. Soon, the show starts and everyone plays their part. Meanwhile, Samrat who wants to spend equal amounts of time with both Sheena and Gunjan, wonders how to solve his dilemma. Later, Sheena tells Samrat that she expects him to choose her.

videos.title: Mayank and Nupur Argue
videos.overview: Nupur overhears Mayank telling Samrat that he thinks he and Nupur are incompatible. When Nupur and Mayank meet each other later, they argue. Meanwhile, Gunjan asks Samrat to break their friendship and focus on his relationship with Sheena. Will both couples separate before they even get together?

videos.title: Samrat Wants Sheena to Trust Him
videos.overview: While Gunjan thinks Samrat wants Sheena, he refuses to give up their friendship. Samrat wants Sheena to believe that he and Gunjan are only friends. Meanwhile, Nupur berates Mayank and says that talking to him is a waste of time. How does Mayank respond to this outburst from Nupur?

videos.title: Samrat Embrase Gunjan
videos.overview: Samrat embrase Gunjan; Meanwhile Uday is delighted when Tamanna calls him dependable. Meanwhile, Mayank decides to give some time to Nupur to calm down and think about their relationship. Nupur regrets having feelings for Mayank and for hugging him during their rehearsal. Will Nupur and Mayank sort out their differences?

videos.title: Samrat Misses Gunjan
videos.overview: Tamanna asks Nupur and Mayank to concentrate on their roles and not get distracted. Meanwhile, Samrat feels very lonely without Gunjan. Later, Rannvijay promises a surprise for Diya after the shows are over. He books a room in an isolated hotel. What are his evil plans?

videos.title: Samrat Feels Awkward With Sheena
videos.overview: Nupur thinks about Mayank and feels sad about what happened between them. Meanwhile, Mayank wants Samrat to be his old self again. During the performance, Sheena hugs Samrat, who feels awkward to reciprocate her hug. Why is Samrat unable to be affectionate towards Sheena?

videos.title: Nupur and Mayank's Final Act
videos.overview: During Mayank and Nupur's final act, they steer clear of the script and dialogue and say things spontaneously. Tamanna and Uday observe that Mayank and Nupur are actually not acting. At the end, Mayank and Nupur do something that shocks Tamanna and Uday.

videos.title: Mayank Expresses to Nupur
videos.overview: Despite being happy that Samrat chose her over Gunjan, Sheena observes that he is depressed. Meanwhile, Uday wants to gift a ring to Tamanna and asks Gunjan's advice. Later, Mayank tells Nupur that he is happy to see her smile and promises to keep her happy. Will it last this time?

videos.title: Sheena Repends for Seperating Gunjan and Samrat
videos.overview: As Uday plans to propose to Tamanna, but she tells him that she is excited as her boyfriend has proposed to her. Meanwhile, Sheena believes she made a mistake by separating Gunjan and Samrat. Mayank and Nupur get caught in heavy rain. Later, Ranvijay takes Diya to the hotel. Will he outrage her modesty?

videos.title: Mayank Promises Nupur
videos.overview: Mayank promises Nupur to change his attitude and not fight with her. Meanwhile, Sheena sets up a romantic candle-light dinner with Samrat, but he does not share her enthusiasm. In an isolated hotel, Diya is overwhelmed with the manner in which Rannvijay arranges her welcome.

videos.title: Uday Confides Nupur, Gunjan
videos.overview: Rannvijay asks Diya to be his girlfriend and she accepts his proposal. Meanwhile, Uday confides in Nupur and Gunjan about how he cannot reveal his love for Tamanna. At the same time, Mayank's mother finds him to be happy. Later, Diya tells Rannvijay something that infuriates him.

videos.title: Samrat Tries to Talk to Gunjan
videos.overview: Samrat tries to talk to Gunjan, but she avoids him. Mayank gets irritated when Uday drags Nupur to the canteen. Mayank then asks Nupur to meet him outside the college campus. Meanwhile, Samrat meets Gunjan and asks her to communicate with him through gestures only.

videos.title: Gunjan to Train Samrat
videos.overview: Shukla asks Samrat a question in the class, and Gunjan answers it. He insists Samrat to spend time with Gunjan to increase his IQ levels. Later, Mayank gifts Nupur a magazine of her choice, and she is happy. Diya takes responsibility of Uday's birthday party plans.

videos.title: No Invite for Sheena
videos.overview: Nupur does not want Diya to invite Sheena to Uday's party. Meanwhile, Rannvijay tells Diya that he is willing to wait till she is comfortable with him and trusts him. Meanwhile, Mayank's mother helps him pick a shirt to wear that Nupur would like. Nupur urges Samrat to try and meet Gunjan.

videos.title: Nupur Locks Up Uday in a Room
videos.overview: Samrat tries to make conversation with Gunjan, but she ignores him. While Diya makes arrangements for the party, Ranvijay pretends to pay attention to her. Meanwhile, in order to keep the party a surprise, Nupur locks Uday in a room. Mayank finds out about this. Will he get more irritated with Uday?

videos.title: Birthday Party Celebration
videos.overview: Diya discusses Rannvijay's proposal with Samrat. He advises her to get to know Rannvijay better before accepting. Meanwhile, when Samrat doesn't find Sheena at the party, he asks about her. Gunjan asks Diya to tell Samrat that Sheena was not invited for the party. How will Samrat react to this?

videos.title: Sheena Comes to the Party
videos.overview: On Samrat's insistence, Sheena comes to the party. Nupur notices that Mayank is hesitant to reveal their relationship. Mayank tells her that they need to be comfortable before telling everyone. Later, Mayank asks Nupur to say 'I love you' to him. Will she do so?

videos.title: Mayank Plans His Date With Nupur
videos.overview: Nupur is excited about her first date with Mayank. Meanwhile, Tamanna tells Uday that she is quitting her job. Later, Mayank seeks help from magazines and his mother and plans a memorable date with Nupur. What has Mayank planned?

videos.title: Mayank Is Disappointed
videos.overview: Mayank feels disappointed as he isn't able to arrange for red roses and a white horse for his date. Meanwhile, Samrat devises a plan to make Gunjan talk to him. He seeks Benji's help with this. What does he plan to do?

videos.title: Nupur and Mayank's First Date
videos.overview: Nupur is upset with Mayank for not coming to the meeting place. Mayank requests her to give him a chance in making their date special. Later, Mayank surprises Nupur with romantic lights, red roses and a white horse. Meanwhile, a note that Gunjan wrote to Samrat, falls in Sheena's hands.

videos.title: Nupur Defends Gunjan
videos.overview: Sheena confronts Gunjan and accuses her of breaking her promise. She threatens to call Samrat and tell him that Gunjan loves him. However, Nupur defends Gunjan and challenges Sheena to call Samrat. Will Sheena reveal the truth to Samrat?

videos.title: Nupur Gives a Gift to Mayank
videos.overview: Mayank pretends to be angry until Nupur says that she loves him. Nupur tries to calm him down by gifting him a heart-shaped locket, but he does not accept it. Meanwhile, a dejected Samrat tells Gunjan that he will respect her decision of staying away from him.

videos.title: Tamanna Awards the Students
videos.overview: Before leaving college, Tamanna awards the students who took part in the drama. Meanwhile, Rannvijay tells Sheena that he can give her good ideas to get Samrat. Sheena wants to surprise Samrat with a small party. Later, Rannvijay requests Samrat to accept his friendship. What's his plan?

videos.title: Ranvijay, Samrat Are Friends
videos.overview: On Sheena and Diya's behest, Samrat agrees to be friends with Rannvijay. Sheena celebrates their friendship with a small party and feels happy that her plan is working. Later, Samrat asks Diya to be careful around Rannvijay. Rannvijay eavesdrops on their conversation.

videos.title: Mayank Misplaces Nupur's Gift
videos.overview: Mayank misplaces the locket Nupur gifted him and begins to panic. He soon finds out that Chinu has the same locket. After a lot of begging, pleading and negotiating, Chinu agrees to give the locket to Mayank. However, Nupur refuses to believe that it's the one she gifted him. How does she know?

videos.title: Nupur Gets Angry With Mayank
videos.overview: Mayank confesses to Nupur that he feels shy to wear a heart-shaped locket. Nupur gets furious for Mayank's negligence. Meanwhile, Samrat spots a packet, but Rannvijay dodges him by saying that it contains medicines. Later, Sheena asks everyone to wear swimming costumes to her party.

videos.title: Nupur Asks Mayank to Apologise
videos.overview: Sheena plans to use the pool party to permanently draw a wedge between Samrat and Gunjan. Meanwhile, Nupur asks Mayank to apologise to her. Mayank says that he has done it once already, and now it's up to her to forgive him. What is Sheena planning against Gunjan?

videos.title: Mayank Is Asked to Relax
videos.overview: Nupur tells Gunjan about herself and Mayank. She feels happy about it and is also excited to see Samrat at Sheena's party. At the party, when Mayank mentions the locket, Nupur asks him to relax. Later, Samrat and Gunjan see each other, but do not speak. Sheena decides to put her plan into action..

videos.title: Nupur Suspects Something Fishy
videos.overview: During the party, Nupur suspects Sheena of planning something. Meanwhile, Benji calls and fools Uday into thinking that he is a girl. Later, Diya announces the start of a game. Sheena devises a plan to make Gunjan stand near the swimming pool. What is Sheena planning?

videos.title: Nupur Sets a Dare for Mayank
videos.overview: As part of the game, everyone has to reveal something controversial, or do something daring. Mayank opts for a dare. Nupur throws the locket into the pool and dares Mayank to retrieve it. Suddenly, Samrat shocks Nupur by telling her that Mayank doesn't know how to swim. Nupur begins to panic.

videos.title: Sheena Says Gunjan Pushed Her
videos.overview: Sheena tells something to Gunjan and then jumps into the pool. Gunjan screams and everyone comes running. Samrat jumps in and brings Sheena out of the pool. Sheena shocks everyone by saying that Gunjan pushed her into the pool. Will Samrat believe Sheena?

videos.title: Samrat Refuses to Believe Sheena
videos.overview: While Sheena blames Gunjan, Nupur, Benji and Uday refuse to believe that Gunjan could have pushed her. Soon, Samrat silences everyone by berating Sheena for lying. He says that he trusts Gunjan completely. Shocked by Samrat's reaction, Sheena threatens to break up with him. What will Samrat do?

videos.title: Sheena Reveals Gunjan's Feelings
videos.overview: Sheena reveals that Gunjan is in love with Samrat. Meanwhile, Mayank gets the pool boy to confess that Sheena bribed him to reduce the water level of the pool. An upset Gunjan storms out and Samrat tries to talk to her. Later, Ranvijay promises to take revenge for Sheena’s insult.

videos.title: Samrat Thanks Sheena
videos.overview: Despite knowing Gunjan's feelings, Samrat tells her that he is happy to be her best friend. Gunjan decides to take some time to accept his friendship again. Later, Samrat thanks Sheena for making him realise what Gunjan means to him. Enraged, Sheena tells Gunjan that she will never let her be happy.

videos.title: Ranvijay Pretends to Be Good
videos.overview: Gunjan feels sad as Samrat still thinks of her as a friend. Nupur tells her to express her love to Samrat. Later, Nupur realises that it is difficult to get true love and so decides to propose Mayank. Meanwhile, Rannvijay pretends to support Samrat by staying with him.

videos.title: Rannvijay Spikes Samrat's Juice
videos.overview: Rannvijay spikes Samrat's juice. Samrat drinks it and begins to feel giddy. Rannvijay manages to move him to his car where Samrat faints. Uday happens to see what seems like Samrat starting his car. What is Rannvijay going to do with the unconscious Samrat?

videos.title: Mayank Surprises Nupur
videos.overview: Gunjan and others find Samrat in an unconscious state. After regaining consciousness, Samrat is arrested by the police. Later, Gunjan learns that Samrat has met with an accident. Meanwhile, Nupur is shocked to see Mayank standing at her doorstep. Why is Mayank there?

videos.title: Samrat Is Arrested
videos.overview: Rannvijay and Sheena are happy about Samrat’s arrest. Meanwhile, Samrat is not able to recollect anything leading up to his arrest. He doesn't even remember drinking alcohol. The police refuse to release him and orders Mayank and the others to leave the police station immediately.

videos.title: Gunjan Is Upset for Samrat
videos.overview: Samrat is shocked when Sheena comes to meet him and she expresses her happiness about his situation. Meanwhile, Mayank's mother informs that Samrat can be released on bail only on Monday Gunjan becomes upset on this. Mayank decides to look for clues near Samrat's house. Will he find anything important?

videos.title: The Inspector Is Bribed
videos.overview: Uday and Benji bribe the inspector on duty and get Gunjan permission to meet Samrat. Gunjan comforts Samrat and apologises for not reaching sooner. Samrat realises that he has begun to feel differently about Gunjan. He struggles to find out why.

videos.title: Mayank Doesn't Believe Rannvijay
videos.overview: Rannvijay yells when Diya holds his hand. She learns that his hand is hurt. Later, Rannvijay narrates a false story about Samrat's accident. However, Mayank picks loopholes in his story and wonders about Rannvijay's hand injury. Will he unmask Rannvijay?

videos.title: Gunjan Assures Samrat
videos.overview: Gunjan reassures Samrat that their friendship will stand the test of time. She is surprised to know that Sheena had come to meet Samrat. Nupur and Mayank unearth a vital clue about Ranvijay's involvement in Samrat's accident. Later, Benji, Uday, Mayank and Nupur are stunned to see Ranvijay holding a gun.

videos.title: Mayank Finds Blood Stains
videos.overview: Nupur, Mayank, Ranvijay and Diya look for clues at the crime spot and enact the accident. Samrat gets restless with Gunjan's nonchalant behaviour towards him. Mayank finds dried blood in the STD booth and collects it as proof. Will this evidence nail the culprit?

videos.title: Gunjan Supports Samrat
videos.overview: Samrat feels guilty about suspecting Gunjan and Mayak, whereas they support him unflinchingly. Gunjan tells him about the proof Mayank has collected. Meanwhile, Diya goes to Ranvijay's house for dinner.

videos.title: Samrat Misses Gunjan
videos.overview: Nupur and Mayank fight over petty issues until Mayank finally buys her some ice-cream. Samrat misses Gunjan more than he cares to admit. Ranvijay and Diya enjoy a romantic rain dance.

videos.title: Samrat Is Surprised to See Gunjan
videos.overview: Mayank, Nupur, Benji and Uday ploy to get Ranvijay's blood samples discreetly. Samrat is pleasantly shocked to see Gunjan at the police station offering him prasad and praying for him. Uday, Benji and Nupur try to distract and irritate Ranvijay with a knife. Will they succeed in collecting evidence?

videos.title: Gunjan Consoles Samrat
videos.overview: Gunjan meets Samrat Meanwhile Everyone vouches for Samrat's non-drinking habit, but Samrat's inability to recollect details of the accident makes the judge suspicious. Lalita tells Mayank that blood samples cannot be used as evidence though it is a vital clue. Diya is elated when Ranvijay gifts her a ring.

videos.title: Samrat Surprises Ranvijay
videos.overview: Ranvijay rejects Diya's proposal and humiliates her. He is surprised to see Samrat, as he was celebrating his revenge against Diya and Samrat. The entire gang is furious at Ranvijay. Will this lead to a new enmity between Samrat and Ranvijay?

videos.title: Ranvijay Instigates Everyone Againt Samrat
videos.overview: Ranvijay mocks the unity between the others and instigates the college management against Samrat, citing his recent accident. Nupur and Gunjan console Diya, who is scared to go to college and finds herself getting attracted to Uday.

videos.title: Nupur Gets an Apology Note
videos.overview: Diya feels guilty for not believing Samrat earlier. Mayank, Nupur, Benji and Uday work out a plan to get solid proof against Ranvijay. Mayank tries to calm Nupur, and sends her an apology note.

videos.title: Diya Slaps Ranvijay
videos.overview: Diya defends Samrat, and slaps Ranvijay. Ranvijay is the victim of a prank, and Mayank, Uday, Benji are happy to see him tensed and upset. Gunjan is worried about Samrat getting to know her feelings.

videos.title: Will Samrat Accept Gunjan?
videos.overview: Ranvijay finds a note in his car that explains why Samrat was not injured in the accident. He thinks that he is being fooled by Benji and Uday, who ask him to attend Samrat’s hearing. Meanwhile, Mayank asks Samrat to accept Gunjan as his girlfriend.

videos.title: Ranvijay Lies in Court
videos.overview: Ranvijay misrepresents the facts of the case to ensure that the case goes against Samrat. Gunjan prays for Samrat's win, while Mayank requests the judge to withhold the verdict as there are no substantive witnesses.

videos.title: Mayank Cross-Examines Ranvijay
videos.overview: Mayank gets a chance to cross examine Ranvijay in court, and gathers up witness against him. Everyone is shocked to discover that Samrat wasn't hurt despite being the victim while Ranvijay had sustained injuries.

videos.title: Samrat Is Proven Innocent
videos.overview: Mayank proves Samrat's innocence and Ranvijay is convicted by the court. While Samrat thanks Gunjan, Nupur is elated with Mayank's win. Samrat, though appreciative of Gunjan, finds it hard to guess her true feelings.

videos.title: Everyone Decides to Party
videos.overview: The gang decides to celebrate Samrat's win by hosting a party in college, and making it a surprise event for Mayank. Gunjan controls her feelings for Samrat, who is equally evasive.

videos.title: Nupur's Misunderstanding
videos.overview: Samrat is evasive about his feelings for Gunjan. Mayank gifts a ring to Nupur, who misunderstands his gesture for a marriage proposal. Everyone is shocked when Samrat rescues Diya, mistaking her to be Gunjan.

videos.title: Mayank, Nupur Are Suspected
videos.overview: Samrat and Mayank celebrate their friendship. Mayank insists that Samrat examine his feelings for Gunjan. Benji and Uday contemplate about Mayank and Nupur's relationship. Later, Mayank consoles a depressed Diya and tells her the importance of true friends and family.

videos.title: Samrat Is in Love With Gunjan
videos.overview: Samrat thinks he is in love with Gunjan as he keeps imagining her presence everywhere. He does not return her friendship band nor responds to her calls. Meanwhile, Nupur is elated about her marriage proposal.

videos.title: Samrat Proposes to Gunjan
videos.overview: Samrat wants to share his feelings with Gunjan and propose to her. Meanwhile, Nupur taunts Samrat and playfully accuses Mayank of being unromantic.

videos.title: Mayank Tries to Pacify Nupur
videos.overview: Samrat indirectly proposes to Gunjan. Meanwhile, Mayank tries to pacify Nupur, but she wants to end their relationship. Gunjan on the other hand, decides to express her feelings to Samrat.

videos.title: Samrat Plans to Propose Gunjan
videos.overview: Uday and Benji give Samrat different ideas to propose Gunjan. However, Samrat ignore them and decides to propose her through music. Nupur is in tears as Mayank doesn't express his feelings in front of others. Will Samrat's proposal impress Gunjan?

videos.title: Nupur, Mayank Start Afresh
videos.overview: Nupur and Mayank begin their love afresh, as Mayank openly expresses his feelings. Meanwhile, Uday is shocked to learn about Mayank and Nupur's relationship. Samrat is eager to propose to Gunjan and brings a bouquet of roses for her.

videos.title: Gunjan Hides From Samrat
videos.overview: Nupur is excited when Mayank includes their marriage in his future plans. Uday and Benji's inquisitiveness irks Mayank. Meanwhile, Samrat decides to give a single rose to Gunjan instead of a bouquet. She hides herself on seeing him. Finally, Samrat sees Gunjan. Why does she avoid him?

videos.title: Diya Learns About Mayank-Nupur
videos.overview: Diya is happy to know about Mayank and Nupur. Gunjan is afraid that her real feelings for Samrat will jeopardise their friendship, and so corrects everyone when they speculate about her and Samrat. He is surprised to hear that Gunjan has no romantic feelings for him.

videos.title: Samrat Misses Gunjan
videos.overview: Gunjan and Samrat are both unaware of each other's feelings. Nupur consoles Gunjan and is rude to Samrat. Diya,Benji and Uday reveal to Nupur that they are aware of her relationship with Mayank.

videos.title: Gunjan Leaves for Morena
videos.overview: Gunjan leaves for Morena and Samrat is depressed. Nupur tells Mayank that Samrat rejected Gunjan's proposal. She also wants to tell him that others are aware of their relationship, but is unable to do so. Champa invites Nupur and Gunjan for a marriage in Morena.

videos.title: Samrat Is Depressed
videos.overview: Mayank attends the surprise party, but later scolds Nupur for revealing their relationship to their friends. Nupur is depressed and decides to accompany Gunjan to Morena apparently Samrat remains depressed. Meanwhile, Mayank remains diverted from studies due to Nupur.

videos.title: Samrat Tries to Stop Gunjan
videos.overview: Mayank repents for his rude behaviour with Nupur. He is surprised to know that Nupur is going to Morena. Samrat tries his best to prevent Gunjan from leaving, but lands himself in trouble with the police for violating traffic rules.

videos.title: Samrat Is Heartbroken
videos.overview: Samrat is heartbroken to find Gunjan's house locked. Nupur is happy to meet Mayank at the bus stop and Gunjan keeps expecting Samrat to turn up. She fails to see Samrat searching for her.

videos.title: Samrat Reads Gunjan's Letter
videos.overview: Uday,Benji and Diya miss Gunjan and Nupur. Mayank regrets his rude behaviour towards Nupur. Samrat reads Gunjan's letter and misses her. Later, Mayank's mother overhears him talking to himself about his love for Nupur.

videos.title: Samrat Confesses to His Friends
videos.overview: Samrat confesses his love for Gunjan to his friends. Mayank decides to go to Morena and meet Npur. Samrat is annoyed as he feels his friends aren't keen to find Gunjan soon.

videos.title: Nupur and Gunja Are Happy
videos.overview: Nupur and Gunjan are happy to be with their family. Nupur turns down a marriage alliance that has been finalised for her. Samrat and others are on their way to Morena when their car breaks down. But, they all reach Morena leater.

videos.title: Gunjan Is Elated
videos.overview: Nupur's aunt mistakenly thinks Mayank is the guy who has been chosen by the family. Gunjan is elated to meet her friends, but keeps wishing that Samrat too was in Morena.

videos.title: Nupur, Mayank Reconcile
videos.overview: Uday, Benji and Diya help Nupur and Mayank iron out their differences. Gunjan imagines Samrat’s presence everywhere, and is shocked to realise that Samrat is actually in Morena.

videos.title: Gunjan Decides to Return
videos.overview: Nupur's aunt is impressed by Mayank and is keen to have Nupur married soon. Samrat questions Gunjan about her feelings, and the lovebirds decide to return to Mumbai.

videos.title: Nupur Gives Ultimatum to Mayank
videos.overview: Gunjan searches for Samrat and the gang plans to make them meet.  Nupur puts forth a condition for Mayank, forbidding him to meet her unless he openly accepts their relationship in front of everyone. Will Mayank accept Nupur's condition?

videos.title: Samrat Shares His Feelings to Gunjan
videos.overview: Samrat tells Gunjan he is in love and she mistakenly thinks it isn’t her. Meanwhile, Mayank agrees to Nupur's condition of accepting their relationship in front of everyone.  Nupur and Gunjan are elated to know that their father will be in Morena soon.

videos.title: Samrat Impresses Bui
videos.overview: Mayank decides to propose to Nupur on Dusshera. Meanwhile, Samrat manages to impress Bui with a cake, but his joy is short-lived as the cake isn't eggless. Bui scolds Samrat for trying to feed her non-veg food. What will Samrat do now?

videos.title: Everyone Enjoys Dusshera
videos.overview: The girls dress up in traditional wear for Dusshera. Samrat tells Gunjan that she will meet someone special during Dusshera and Mayank prepares himself to propose  Nupur.

videos.title: Nupur Is Worried
videos.overview: Gunjan is perplexed with Samrat's behaviour. Nupur is scared about Mayank's surprise. As the gang celebrates Dusshera, Mayank realises that he has misplaced the necklace, which his mother had gifted for Nupur. Samrat asks Gunjan to pray  that his special person will accept his proposal.

videos.title: Mayank Leaves Morena Immediately
videos.overview: Mayank decides to leave Morena immediately. Nupur is excited about the surprise and waits for Mayank. Will Nupur learn that Mayank left Morena without meetin her. Meanwhile,  Samrat confesses his love for Gunjan. Will Gunjan accept Samrat's proposal?

videos.title: Samrat's Promise to Gunjan
videos.overview: Nupur is waiting expectantly for Mayank when she comes to know from Pinky that Mayank has left Morena. Gunjan is elated to know about Samrat's love for her, and they embrace. Samrat promises to never let Gunjan cry again.

videos.title: Nupur, Gunjan Meet Their Father
videos.overview: Diya, Benji and Uday are happy to know about Samrat and Gunjan. Nupur is upset with Mayank's sudden departure, but remains composed in front of Gunjan. Nupur and Gunjan are happy to meet their father at Morena. Later, The girls meet their father at Morena.

videos.title: Bui Scolds Nupur
videos.overview: Everyone is shocked when Bui tells that she has seen Samrat with another girl. Samrat and Gunjan are shocked when Bui scolds Nupur for concealing the fact that Mayank left for Mumbai. The gang supports Samrat when Bui speaks ill of him.

videos.title: Bui Stops Nupur From Leaving
videos.overview: Diya and Uday argue with Bui. Nupur is still perplexed with Mayank's sudden departure, but Bui forbids Gunjan and Nupur from leaving Morena. The gang is happy with Samrat's decision of not separating Gunjan from her father and Nupur.

videos.title: Champa Throws Mayank's Letter
videos.overview: Mayank comes to know that Nupur is still in Morena. Gunjan is distraught at Samrat's departure. Champa throws away Mayank's letter. The gang bid good bye to Gunjan, Nupur and Bui.

videos.title: Samrat Apologises to Bui
