videos.overview: Gunjan's father is impressed with Samrat, but Bui refuses to forgive him. Mayank is happy to know about Nupur's arrival in Mumbai, but is unaware that she has no clue about his letter.

videos.title: Nupur Resolves to Forget Mayank
videos.overview: Mayank resolves to sort out his differences with Nupur, but she is hurt and angry. Gunjan and Samrat celebrate their love, while Nupur decides to start her life afresh, without Mayank.

videos.title: Nupur Is Heartbroken
videos.overview: Nupur learns about Mayank’s plan to shift to Bangalore. A heartbroken Nupur decides not to think about Mayank and starts maintaining distance from him. Mayank tries speaking to Nupur, but fails. Meanwhile, Samrat is happy to see his relationship with Gunjan blossom. Will Mayank win Nupur back?

videos.title: Nupur Avoids Mayank
videos.overview: Nupur acts happy and normal in everyone's presence.  Mayank is upset with Diya and Benji's cold behaviour towards him. He tries to speak to Nupur, but she avoids him. Will Mayank win Nupur's love back?

videos.title: Mayank and Nupur Break Up
videos.overview: Nupur does not come to the library to meet Mayank, complicating things further. Samrat comes to know that Mayank is relocating to Bangalore. Mayank decides to break up with Nupur.

videos.title: Gunjan and Samrat Help Mayank
videos.overview: Mayank explains to Samrat his reasons for relocating to Bangalore.  Gunjan realises that Samrat is already aware of Nupur's break-up and they decide to help Mayank and Nupur resolve their misunderstandings.

videos.title: Diya, Gunjan Plan a Surprise
videos.overview: Diya and Gunjan arrange a surprise meeting between Nupur and Mayank. Samrat asks Mayank to help him decorate a room. Nupur is pleasantly surprised with Mayank's gesture and asks him not to leave her and go.

videos.title: Nupur Confess Her Love
videos.overview: Nupur confesses her love for Mayank, but he decides to leave her. Gunjan and Diya console Nupur and they decide to stop Mayank from leaving. Mayank's mother realises her son's plight. The gang reaches the bus stop but it is too late.

videos.title: Nupur Faints at Bus Stop
videos.overview: Heartbroken, Nupur faints at the bus stop. She regains consciousness only to find Mayank beside her. Mayank proposes to an elated Nupur, and the gang celebrates their union. Mayank's mother is proud of her son and how he stood up for his love.

videos.title: Mayank Cancels Bangalore Plan
videos.overview: Nupur clears her misgivings with Mayank. He decides against going to Bangalore. They get stuck in traffic and finally reach a remote village. Samrat and Gunjan bask in their love for each other, dreaming of a more committed relationship with each other.

videos.title: Gunjan Sees Masked Intruder
videos.overview: Nupur assures Mayank that she will stay happy even after he leaves Mumbai. Gunjan sees a masked intruder in the college, stealing Samrat's application and tells him about the incident. Samrat does not believe her.

videos.title: Mayank Gives Nupur the Necklace
videos.overview: Mayank gifts his mother's necklace to Nupur before leaving Mumbai. Prof Shukla asks Diya to help a new student. Nupur comes to know that Bablu has come to Excel College and the gang decides to mislead him by calling Nupur by a new name.

videos.title: Uday Falls for Gang's Prank
videos.overview: Instead of Bablu, Uday falls for the gang's prank. Meanwhile, Benji is fascinated by the new girl in his college. Later, Nupur calls Mayank to tell him about Bablu's arrival in Mumbai.

videos.title: Adhiraj and Nupur Meet
videos.overview: The gang decides to make a fool of Bablu but he manages to impress the new girl. He introduces himself as Adhiraj to the new girl and everyone is shocked when the new girl calls herself Nupur.

videos.title: Samrat to Trick Adhiraj
videos.overview: Gunjan and Diya strike a friendship with the new girl. Ceejay helps Samrat to trick Adhiraj. Diya stops the new girl from meeting Adhiraj, who keeps searching for Nupur in Excel College.

videos.title: Adhiraj, the New Basketball Coach
videos.overview: The gang is shocked to know that Adhiraj is the new basketball coach. Samrat is jealous when Gunjan praises Adhiraj. Nupur tries to pass a chit to the new girl but Uday mistakenly gives it to Adhiraj.

videos.title: Nupur Meets New Girl
videos.overview: Nupur tells the new girl about her relationship with Mayank, and also about Adhiraj's proposal. Later, she is worried if the new girl will reveal her secret. Mayank decides to surprise Nupur. The new girl is worried that she has misplaced Samrat's photo.

videos.title: Adhiraj Visits Nupur's Home
videos.overview: Adhiraj comes to visit Nupur. The gang is shocked to see him and convinces him that the new Nupur is at home. Adhiraj is left waiting to meet her. The new girl agrees to accompany Samrat to Nupur's house.

videos.title: Samrat and Gunjan
videos.overview: Adhiraj asks the new girl to speak to Bui, who insists that Nupur accept Adhiraj's proposal. Samrat and Gunjan share a romantic moment, but Samrat accidentally falls off the balcony.

videos.title: Nupur Is Well Aware of Samrat's Habits
videos.overview: Adhiraj feels that the new Nupur is impressed with him. Mayank tells Nupur to inform him if there is any problem. Gunjan is surprised to know that the new Nupur is well aware of Samrat's habits. Who is she?

videos.title: Gunjan Is Worried
videos.overview: Samrat gets upset thinking about his sister. Gunjan is worried about the new girl's keen interest in Samrat. She discovers her true identity to be Suhani Shergill. Who is Suhaani?

videos.title: Suhaani Is Samrat's Sister
videos.overview: The gang learns about Adhiraj's real intention of gathering support for himself. Suhaani reveals to Gunjan that she is Samrat's sister and asks her to keep her identity a secret. Nupur and Mayank feel that they have a communication gap between them.

videos.title: Samrat Scolds Suhaani
videos.overview: Adhiraj and Samrat compete against each other in basketball. Gunjan convinces Suhaani to reveal her identity to Samrat. Adhiraj apologises to Suhaani. Has he started to fall in love with her?

videos.title: Gunjan to Unite Suhaani, Samrat
videos.overview: Gunjan vows to bring Samrat and Sunhaani together once again. Nupur suspects Adhiraj of being in love with Suhaani. She is elated to see Mayank, as he pays her a surprise visit.

videos.title: Samrat and Adhiraj Team Up
videos.overview: Samrat and Adhiraj team up to win the zonal basketball competition. Samrat is puzzled about why Nupur reminds him of his childhood, while Suhani impersonates Nupur in front of Adhiraj.

videos.title: Nupur Wants to Tell the Truth
videos.overview: Adhiraj's question about her pendant catches Suhani off guard. As their relationship starts blossoming, Nupur wants to tell Adhiraj the truth to avoid any confusion later. Suhani agrees to meet Adhiraj outside college.

videos.title: Mayank Plays a Prank
videos.overview: Mayank disguises himself to play a prank on Nupur, who takes it in good spirit. Meanwhile, Gunjan is elated to see Samrat's dedication towards his basketball practice.

videos.title: Suhani's Photo Album With Samrat
videos.overview: Gunjan is tense when Samrat picks up Suhani's photo album and prevents him from seeing it. Mayank surprises Nupur with a gift. Suhani and Nupur decide to foil Adhiraj's plans to visit Diya's house. What is Mayank's gift?

videos.title: Adhiraj in Diya's House
videos.overview: Samrat and Gunjan help Nupur to stop Adhiraj from entering Diya's house. Nupur is shocked to see Suhani with Adhiraj, while Samrat and Gunjan are perplexed to find Nupur in the house. How will this confusion end?

videos.title: Mayank Meets Adhiraj
videos.overview: Mayank is shocked to learn about Adhiraj's impending marriage with Nupur. Meanwhile, Adhiraj questions Suhani about Mayank. Sensing the confusion, Gunjan advises Nupur to clear the mystery. Will Adhiraj forgive Nupur and Suhani?

videos.title: Mayank Accuses Nupur
videos.overview: Mayank accuses Nupur of two-timing him but later apologises to her. Meanwhile, Gunjan tries to warn Suhani about Nupur's confession to Adhiraj.

videos.title: Mayank Insists Suhani to Tell the Truth.
videos.overview: Gunjan reveals Suhani's real identity to Nupur and Mayank. Mayank insists that Suhani tell the truth to Adhiraj, but she is worried it may end their relationship. What will Suhani do?

videos.title: Samrat Is Angry With Suhani
videos.overview: Samrat is annoyed when Gunjan and Suhani try to remind him of his childhood. Adhiraj comforts Suhani, while Nupur decides to disclose the truth to Adhiraj after the basketball tournament. How will Adhiraj react?

videos.title: Adhiraj Is Annoyed With Samrat
videos.overview: Samrat relishes the kheer made by Suhani. Bui plans to come to Mumbai. Uday joins the basketball team, while Adhiraj is furious at Samrat for coming in late. Will Adhiraj forgive Samrat?

videos.title: Suhani Ties Rakhi to Samrat
videos.overview: Suhani ties rakhi to Samrat. Gunjan asks Samrat to accept Suhani as his sister. Bui comes to meet Nupur. At the basketball game, Adhiraj allows the opposition to take the ball from him, costing the team a point. Will Samrat accept this?

videos.title: Adhiraj Fights With Samrat
videos.overview: Samrat and Adhiraj fight with each other during the game. The opponents take advantage of the situation and equalise the score. Dismayed by the internal conflicts, the principal suspends Adhiraj and Samrat from the team. Meanwhile, Mayank apologises to Bui. Will she forgive him?

videos.title: Adhiraj and Samrat Team Up
videos.overview: Adhiraj and Samrat agree to let go of their ego and partner for the upcoming tournament. The Excels emerge victorious and the college celebrates its success. Meanwhile, Suhani is shocked to learn that Yuvraj is aware of her real identity. Later, Samrat gets injured and becomes unconscious.

videos.title: Samrat Is Hospitalised
videos.overview: Samrat is hospitalised after his injury. While a worried Gunjan tries to wake Samrat up by talking about his lover, Adhiraj consoles an upset Suhani. Later, Suhani decides to disclose the truth to Adhiraj. Meanwhile, Gunjan and Atul learn that Samrat is missing.

videos.title: Samrat Questions Suhani
videos.overview: Samrat questions Suhani about her concern towards him. He also asks about her real identity. Suhani apologises to Samrat for hiding the truth from him, but he refuses to forgive her. Meanwhile, Adhiraj is furious with Suhani for playing with his feelings to get closer to Samrat. Will they forgive her?

videos.title: Suhani Is Worried for Adhiraj
videos.overview: Samrat learns that Gunjan and his friends knew the truth all along and decides to give up his friendship with them. Meanwhile, Suhani is worried for Adhiraj as she has betrayed him. Mayank tells the gang not to give up on Samrat. Will they help Mayank in showing the truth to Samrat?

videos.title: Samrat Is Furious With Suhani
videos.overview: Samrat is furious thinking that Suhani separated him from his mother and Gunjan. Adhiraj decides to talk to Suhani to clear his misunderstandings. Meanwhile, Suhani arrives at Samrat’s place to tell him the truth about their mother. How will Samrat react?

videos.title: Mayank Hands Over the Letter
videos.overview: Nupur decides to visit Adhiraj’s house and tell him the truth. Meanwhile, Mayank hands over Suhani’s apology letter to Samrat. Suhani decides to leave Mumbai. She calls Adhiraj, but fails to talk to him. Samrat gets emotional after reading the letter.

videos.title: Adhiraj Wants to Know the Truth
videos.overview: Adhiraj insists that Nupur must reveal the truth in front of everyone. Bui is furious with Nupur when she learns the truth and she slaps her. Meanwhile, Mayank wants Samrat to trust Gunjan and tries to clear all the misunderstandings. Mayank asks Samrat not to break up with Gunjan.

videos.title: Adhiraj Apologises to Suhani
videos.overview: Adhiraj decides to apologise to Suhani. Meanwhile, Samrat visits Suhani’s place and is shocked to learn that she has vacated already. Adhiraj apologises to Suhani. However, Suhani’s revelation upsets him.

videos.title: Mayank Confesses His Love
videos.overview: Mayank confesses to Bui about his relationship with Nupur. Meanwhile, Adhiraj refuses to forgive Suhani. Later, he admits his love for Suhani and is surprised when she tells him about her feelings for him.

videos.title: Samrat Defends Suhani
videos.overview: Adhiraj is surprised to see Samrat defending Suhani. Suhani talks to Samrat about his mother and he feels disturbed. Meanwhile, Nupur is upset about something.

videos.title: Gunjan Favours Mayank
videos.overview: Samrat and Mayank decide to sneak into Nupur's room. Meanwhile, Gunjan explains to her father about Mayank. Later, she tells Samrat to stop Mayank from going to Nupur's house.

videos.title: Nupur to Convince Her Father
videos.overview: Adhiraj is hurt by Suhani's behaviour. Meanwhile, when Nupur tries to convince her father about Mayank, Bui talks against him. Later, Nupur's father decides to meet Mayank.

videos.title: Bauji Disapproves of Mayank
videos.overview: Mayank sneaks into Nupur's room and consoles her. Bauji overhears Mayank's conversation with Nupur and disapproves of him. Nupur is heartbroken.

videos.title: Diya,Gunjan Try to Console Nupur
videos.overview: Adhiraj agrees to marry Nupur and Suhani is shocked about it. Meanwhile, Diya and Gunjan try to console Nupur.

videos.title: What Is Nupur's Father Decision?
videos.overview: An upset Suhani congratulates Adhiraj on his wedding. Meanwhile, Nupur is shocked by her father's decision. Later, when Gunjan tries to stand up for Nupur, she asks her not to do so. Afterwards, Samrat talks to Adhiraj about his decision to marry Nupur.

videos.title: Mayank Learns About the Wedding
videos.overview: Mayank learns about Nupur's wedding and he is upset. Meanwhile, Samrat and Gunjan clear their misunderstandings. Later, Diya and Samrat make plans to stop the wedding. Will they be successful?

videos.title: The Engagement Day
videos.overview: Adhiraj wants Suhani to prevent him from getting engaged. Meanwhile, Nupur tries to talk to her father about Mayank. Can she convince him?

videos.title: Adhiraj Invites Suhani
videos.overview: Adhiraj invites Suhani for his engagement. Suhani confesses her love for Adhiraj. Later, Samrat and Gunjan request Adhiraj to reconsider his decision to marry Nupur.

videos.title: Samrat Thanks Gunjan
videos.overview: Gunjan consoles Suhani and is thanked for her affection by Samrat. Nupur, meanwhile, is surprised when Mayank asks her to get engaged to Adhiraj. Later, Uday and Benji play tricks with the pandit to keep him away from the venue. Will they be able to manage the situation?

videos.title: Gunjan Learns About Dia
videos.overview: Gunjan and Samrat learn that Dia helped Nupur run away from the house and Samrat rushes to bring her back. Nupur meets Mayank, who is not in favour of running away from the situation, and he asks her to return. Will Nupur listen to Mayank?

videos.title: Suhani Pretends to Be Nupur
videos.overview: Suhani pretends to be Nupur to prevent people from knowing that Nupur is not at home. Adhiraj talks to Suhani mistaking her to be Nupur. Later, the real Nupur returns on Mayank's promise to save her from the engagement. Will Mayank be able to keep his promise?

videos.title: Engagement Ceremony
videos.overview: Everyone is happy to see Nupur back home but Nupur herself is shocked to learn that Mayank has failed to speak with Adhiraj. Later, Nupur and Adhiraj are asked to exchange rings. Will the gang be able to stop this engagement or will Nupur get officially engaged to Adhiraj?

videos.title: Mayank Confronts Adhiraj
videos.overview: Samrat tells Gunjan about his mother’s visit to Mumbai and she convinces him to meet her. Mayank tries to confront Adhiraj but is given the cold shoulder. Adhiraj and his family visit Nupur's house for the mehendi ceremony where Mayank comes in disguise. Will he be able to meet Nupur or will he be caught?

videos.title: Mayank Meets Nupur
videos.overview: Mayank meets Nupur, making her happy. He apologises to Adhiraj for hurting him and also tries to convince him to not marry to Nupur as they do not love each other. What will Adhiraj decide to do?

videos.title: Mayank Convince Adhiraj
videos.overview: Adhiraj reads a letter written by Suhani and is angered, thinking she lied to him. Everyone is then made aware of the letter and expect Adhiraj to say yes to the wedding with Nupur. Mayank, Uday and Benji try to convince Adhiraj one last time.

videos.title: Adhiraj Is Unsure
videos.overview: Bui tries to convince Nupur that Mayank is not the right man for her, while Mayank tells her that they will not separate at any cost. Gunjan, meanwhile, is worried about her and Samrat’s separation. Adhiraj, too, is unsure about his marriage to Nupur and begins to miss Suhani.

videos.title: Mayank,Samrat Try Once Again
videos.overview: Mayank and Samrat ask Adhiraj to change his decision regarding marrying Nupur once more. Adhiraj falls unconscious and Nupur learns about his ill-health. She then ruins her wedding outfit to try and stop the marriage, which Gunjan shows to her aunt. Will this trick played by the girls work?

videos.title: Mayank Replaces Adhiraj
videos.overview: Bauji, Nupur and Gunjan are sad thinking about Nupur’s departure and Nupur is missing her mother, too. Mayank replaces Adhiraj and sits on the horse. Nupur is happy with the replacement but Suhani is worried about Adhiraj’s whereabouts. Where is Adhiraj? Will Mayank succeed in his plan?

videos.title: Adhiraj Learns the Truth
videos.overview: Adhiraj learns of Mayank attending the wedding as the groom. Mayank, meanwhile, hides his face under the sehera and decides not to deceive Bauji. Nupur also agrees with Mayank and they decide to part ways. Will they sacrifice their love?

videos.title: Mayank Reveals the Truth
videos.overview: Mayank reveals his identity and confesses his feelings for Nupur, which infuriates Nupur’s father. Feeling betrayed, he taunts Mayank. Adhiraj’s father, on the other hand, stops the wedding and criticises Nupur’s family for hiding her affair with Mayank.

videos.title: Shashi Bhushan Shocks Everyone
videos.overview: Everyone is surprised when Shashi Bhushan agrees for Nupur and Mayank’s marriage and asks Mayank if he will marry Nupur. The two get married but Shashi refuses to bless the newlyweds, and disowns Nupur.

videos.title: Mayank Is Worried
videos.overview: Mayank is worried about the future and his friends try to find a solution. Samrat and Gunjan plan how they all will sneak inside the college. Will they be successful in their plan? Will Mayank and Nupur be able to find happiness with each other?

videos.title: Nupur Assures Mayank
videos.overview: Nupur assures Mayank that they have made the right decision and that they will soon win over her father. The college finds out about Mayank and Nupur’s wedding. Mayank’s mother meets Nupur’s father and asks him to accept the children. Will she be able to convince Bauji?

videos.title: Mayank's Love for Nupur
videos.overview: Gunjan requests her father to accept Nupur and Mayank's relationship but he refuses. Mayank doesn't let Nupur work,insisting on completing her education, while Adhiraj helps Mayank to seek a job as a counselor in Excel college.

videos.title: Mayank Gets a Job
videos.overview: Mayank gets a job of a counsellor. Samrat confesses his love for Gunjan in front of the college. When the security guard does not allow Mayank and Nupur to stay in the college hostel, Samrat requests them to stay in his outhouse.

videos.title: Nupur Speaks Sarcastically
videos.overview: Adhiraj apologises to Suhani. The gang helps Mayank and Nupur in cleaning Samrat’s outhouse. Nupur speaks sarcastically with Gunjan and asks her about her views on their marriage. Will Nupur clarify her thoughts with Gunjan?

videos.title: Nupur Is Irritated
videos.overview: Suhani asks Adhiraj to be her slave for a week if he truly wants to apologise. Nupur is irritated with herself for questioning Gunjan and fighting with Mayank. Samrat, meanwhile, asks Gunjan out on a date, but Nupur persuades her not to go.

videos.title: Suhani Punishes Adhiraj
videos.overview: Suhani punishes Adhiraj after finding an outfit missing. Students are shocked to see Adhiraj wearing only a towel. Later, Dia helps Gunjan prepare for her date with Samrat, but Nupur plans to prevent her from going out.

videos.title: Nupur Worried About Gunjan
videos.overview: Gunjan is shocked to hear Nupur speak ill of Samrat and defends him. However, Mayank is happy to learn about their love. In the farmhouse, Nupur shocks Mayank by informing him that she wants to rescue Gunjan from Samrat’s evil plans. The duo end up arguing with each other.

videos.title: Adhiraj Proposes to Suhani
videos.overview: Nupur is hurt when Gunjan speaks in favour of her father and misunderstandings build up between the two. Mayank and Samrat try to pacify both sisters, but in vain. Meanwhile, Adhiraj apologises to Suhani and proposes to her.

videos.title: Mayank Helps Gunjan
videos.overview: Gunjan and Nupur's library forms are swapped by the gang. Mayank helps Gunjan in filling Nupur’s form and asks her to get the principal’s signature. Nupur continues to misunderstand Samrat and decides to protect her sister from him.

videos.title: Nupur and Gunjan Argue
videos.overview: Nupur asks Gunjan to stay away from Samrat but is told not to interfere by her sister. The simmering tension between the sisters worries Samrat and Mayank. The gang plans to get both sisters reconcile and care for each other.

videos.title: Nupur Saves Gunjan
videos.overview: Nupur saves Gunjan from eve-teasers, which gives them a chance to finally clear the air and sort out their differences. Gunjan tells Nupur about her feelings for Samrat and tries to pacify her. Nupur plans to surprise Mayank on Valentine’s Day.

videos.title: Valentine's Day Planning
videos.overview: Nupur is planning a surprise for Mayank on Valentine’s Day with Diya’s help. Adhiraj wants to propose to Suhani on Valentine’s Day and discusses his plan with Samrat. Gunjan learns about Samrat’s plan for Valentine’s Day and shares it with Nupur. Will Nupur be happy for Gunjan?

videos.title: Samrat Had No Plans to Propose
videos.overview: Adhiraj proposes to Suhani and they are crowned as Valentine king and queen. Mayank surprises Nupur with his new offer letter. Meanwhile, Gunjan learns that Samrat had not planned to propose. Later, some goons enter Excel College and confront Gunjan. Who will protect her?

videos.title: Valentine's Day Special
videos.overview: Gunjan and Samrat meet at the Valentine's Day party. Suhaani and Adhiraj win the best couple award. Adhiraj proposes to Suhaani. Gunjan is upset as Samrat does not propose her. Mayank and Nupur share a romantic moment. Adhiraj tries to save Gunjan from miscreants. Later, Gunjan gets shot!

videos.title: Samrat Is Shocked
videos.overview: Samrat is shocked as Gunjan is shot. Adhiraj files a police complaint. Gunjan’s father learns about the incident, but refuses to accept Nupur as his daughter. Samrat blames himself for Gunjan’s condition. Will Gunjan’s condition improve?

videos.title: Samrat Is Worried About Gunjan
videos.overview: The doctor informs everyone about Gunjan’s critical condition, which upsets her father. Mayank tries to console him, but he refuses to talk to him. Meanwhile, Samrat learns that Gunjan was expecting a proposal from him. Depressed, he blames himself for the situation. Will Gunjan regain consciousness?

videos.title: Samrat Is Furious
videos.overview: Samrat is furious when he sees the same goon in the hospital. Later, Gunjan’s condition becomes critical and Samrat tries to wake her up. Shashi then enquires about Gunjan and Samrat’s relationship. Meanwhile, Adhiraj tells Mayank that he is unable to get any information from the police.

videos.title: Jitendra Meets the Gang
videos.overview: Youth leader Jitendra meets Gunjan’s family and assures of his help in her case. However, Yash, the guy who shot Gunjan, turns out to be Jitendra’s brother. While Shashi is annoyed to see Samrat’s concern for Gunjan, the doctor learns about numbness in Gunjan’s leg. Is everything fine with Gunjan?

videos.title: Adhiraj Is Arrested
videos.overview: Jitendra betrays the gang and gets Adhiraj arrested for the attempt on Gunjan’s life. He also gives Suhani a threatening call and tells Yash to teach the gang a lesson. Nupur tries to tell Gunjan the truth about her condition, but ends up crying. Will the gang be able to prove Yash guilty?

videos.title: Samrat Is Advised
videos.overview: The Principal advises Samrat to not argue with the police officers. After being discharged from the hospital, Gunjan requests Nupur to never sympathise on her condition. The gang is surprised to see Gunjan smiling even on the wheel chair. Meanwhile, Yash threatens the gang.

videos.title: Samrat Is Shocked
videos.overview: Samrat is shocked to know about Gunjan’s paralysis and offers to help her. Meanwhile, Shashi apologises to Samrat for his misbehaviour on Valentine’s Day. Later, Jitendra asks the gang to withdraw their complaint against Yash, but Nupur refuses to do so.

videos.title: Gunjan Refuses to Marry Samrat
videos.overview: Excel college students go on strike to throw Nupur and Gunjan out of the college. Mayank tries to reason out with the students, but fails. Meanwhile, Jitendar Devraj blames Adhiraj for Gunjan's condition. A paralysed Gunjan feels she is not fit for Samrat’s love and refuses to marry him.

videos.title: Nupur Worried About Mayank
videos.overview: The police do not allow Mayank to meet Adhiraj in jail. Nupur is worried about Jitendar’s threatening calls. Later, Nupur and Jitendar have a live debate on TV. The debate ends with Jitendar agreeing to release Adhiraj. The gang is excited to see his release live on TV.

videos.title: Adhiraj Is Released
videos.overview: Adhiraj is bailed out and the gang plans to take action against Jitendra. Meanwhile, one of Jitendra’s men tries to throw acid on Nupur’s face, but Mayank saves her. Samrat and Mayank decide to fight against Jitendra.

videos.title: Gunjan Receives a Call
videos.overview: The doctor tells Nupur that tension might cause Gunjan’s health to deteriorate. Later, Nupur receivess a call informing her of Mayank’s critical condition in a hospital and she leaves home. Is Mayank really sick or is this another trap?

videos.title: Nupur Escapes
videos.overview: Jitendra’s men follow Nupur and Gunjan asks her to reach the police station to escape from them. Nupur manages to get Jitendra arrested and also beats up Yash in public. The college is reopened and the gang gets excited to see things back in control. Will Jitendra seek revenge?

videos.title: Holi Celebrations
videos.overview: The principal thanks the students for getting justice for Gunjan and to the college. The gang and the students celebrate Holi. Gunjan and Samrat remember their previous Holi together. Will everything get back to normal between Gunjan and Samrat?

videos.title: Uday Misunderstands Nupur
videos.overview: Nupur is high after having bhang and Uday misunderstands her. Gunjan is reluctant to play Holi with Samrat and decides to not be a part of his life. The news of Gunjan’s recovery surprises all and Samrat makes her walk with the help of a stretcher.

videos.title: Gunjan Avoids Samrat
videos.overview: Samrat encourages Gunjan to manage things alone, but she decides to stay away from him. Samrat promises himself that he will not let anything affect his and Gunjan’s relationship and decides to take her to a resort so that she can recover completely. Will Gunjan agree to go with him?

videos.title: Gunjan Agrees to Go to the Resort
videos.overview: Mayank reveals Samrat’s plan to Gunjan and becomes happy when Gunjan and Nupur agree to accompany them to a resort. Meanwhile, Adhiraj plans to take Suhani to a romantic place. The gang gets excited and starts planning for the trip. Will Samrat’s purpose for the trip be fulfilled?

videos.title: Samrat Meets Gunjan
videos.overview: Samrat requests Nupur to convince Gunjan to go out for a walk with him. When he meets her, he tries to make her walk. However, Gunjan wants Samrat to leave her alone. Meanwhile, Nupur tells Mayank that a guy is trying to scare her.

videos.title: Gunjan Is Pranked
videos.overview: Uday and Benji scare Gunjan when she goes in search of Samrat. Meanwhile, Suhani leaves a message for Adhiraj asking him to meet her in the garden. Later, Mayank pretends to be a ghost and tries to scare Nupur.

videos.title: Gunjan's Partial Recovery
videos.overview: Gunjan is scared of a ghost and falls from her wheel chair. When Samrat comes to help her, she hugs him. Meanwhile, on Mayank’s insistence, Nupur comes to meet him near the swimming pool, where she bumps into Adhiraj. She suspects Adhiraj to be the person who scared her.

videos.title: Gang Plans to Cure Gunjan
videos.overview: The gang plans to help Gunjan recover. The hotel manager wants the gang to leave the hotel, but Samrat and Mayank convince him to let them extend their stay. Meanwhile, a ghost scares Gunjan by threatening to kill Samrat.

videos.title: Samrat Pretends to Be Scared
videos.overview: Gunjan receives a call asking her to come to the outhouse, where Uday scares her by pretending to be possessed by a ghost. Gunjan is shocked to see Uday trying to kill her with a knife and Samrat also pretends to be scared. Gunjan is shocked when Uday beats up Samrat. What will happen next?

videos.title: Gunjan Pacifies Nupur
videos.overview: The gang is happy to see Gunjan recovered and Samrat thanks her for saving his life. He then confesses his love for her in front of the gang. Meanwhile, Nupur is angry with Mayank when she learns that he kissed a girl during Holi celebrations. Gunjan then tries to pacify Nupur.

videos.title: A Baby Is Found in the Garden
videos.overview: Samrat, Adhiraj, Benji, Uday and Mayank are worried as they receive similar text messages from a stranger and are shocked to find a baby in the garden. They first suspect Mayank, and later Samrat to be the father of the baby.

videos.title: The Boys Take Care of the Child
videos.overview: The boys decide to take care of the baby till they find the real father. Meanwhile, Gunjan imagines a ghost and gets scared. Later, Diya questions Uday and Benji when she meets them in a chemist shop. On the other hand, Nupur calls Maynak and hears a baby cry in the background.

videos.title: Mayank Brings the Baby Home
videos.overview: Mayank takes the baby home. Samrat and Mayank are anxious, and Nupur assumes that Mayank is planning to surprise her. They initially hide the baby under the bed, but spot the baby later under the dining table. Mayank and Samrat manage to take the baby to the room.

videos.title: Nupur Suspects Mayank
videos.overview: Nupur and Gunjan suspect Mayank of having an extramarital affair, and visit the house, where Mayank does not allow them to enter the room. Samrat hides the baby in the bathroom and eventually tries to sneak out of the house with the baby, but Gunjan catches them. What will the boys do now?

videos.title: Baby Goes Missing
videos.overview: The boys plan to search for the baby’s mother and return the baby to her. However, they are shocked when the baby goes missing. Later, the girls find an abandoned baby in the college and decide to take care of it. Meanwhile, Mayank feels uncomfortable to meet Riya, principal’s daughter.

videos.title: Samrat Furious at Mayank
videos.overview: Mayank and Samrat’s change in behaviour worries Nupur and Gunjan. Meanwhile, Nupur, who suspects Mayank of having an illicit affair with Riya, suggests he should help her find the baby’s parents. Samrat is furious to learn about Mayank’s past relationship with Riya. Is the baby Riya’s?

videos.title: Gunjan Misunderstands Mayank
videos.overview: Gunjan misunderstands Mayank and is happy to know that the baby’s mother is Riya. Mayank is relieved to know that Riya is not the mother of the baby. Nupur and Gunjan fight with Riya when she refuses to accept the baby. But suddenly, the baby goes missing.

videos.title: Search for the Mother Begins
videos.overview: Nupur, Gunjan, Suhani and Diya pretend to be upset with the guys. However, the girls get tired trying to console the baby. Meanwhile, Samrat, Uday, Benji, Mayank and Adhiraj seek a detective’s help to locate the baby’s mother.

videos.title: Boys Hire a Detective
videos.overview: The boys take help of detective Dibakar to find the baby’s mother. Meanwhile, Nupur calls a helpline for getting tips to check if Mayank still loves her. The boys want baby’s hair for a DNA test, but the girls ignore them. Whose baby is it?

videos.title: Benji Tries to Cut Baby's Hair
videos.overview: Samrat talks to the girl who wants to play basketball with him, but she refuses to tell her name. Benji and Uday try to cut the baby’s hair by diverting Diya’s attention. Later, Anita meets Mayank and Uday separately and enquires about the baby. Meanwhile, Dibakar suspects Anita to be the baby’s mother.

videos.title: Samrat Lies to the Gang
videos.overview: Samrat receives Dibakar’s call and lies that it was his friend Harry’s call. He later receives Tanya’s call and agrees to meet her for coffee. Meanwhile, Anita requests Mayank and Samrat to meet her.

videos.title: Tanya Blindfolds Samrat
videos.overview: Samrat agrees to Tanya’s condition of blindfolding him which surprises Gunjan. Tanya asks Samrat to search for her and kiss her. Samrat agrees but wants Tanya to answer his questions. Will Tanya agree to answer Samrat’s questions? What does he want to ask?

videos.title: Nupur and Mayank Is Upset With Tanya
videos.overview: Samrat’s closeness with Tanya upsets Gunjan, Mayank and Nupur. Tanya tells the gang that she and Samrat met in Goa for the first time. Benji spreads rumours of a terrorist attack and makes the gang leave the location. The boys learn about the sting operation that the girls did on them. What is the truth?

videos.title: The Girls Confront Uday, Benji
videos.overview: Mayank and Samrat get worried about the blame that has been put on them but Samrat knows that Gunjan will forgive him. Uday refuses to visit Nupur’s house to get the baby’s belongings but later visits with Benji. The girls confront Uday and Benji. What are the girls planning?

videos.title: The Final Task
videos.overview: After losing the first and the second task respectively, the girls and the boys gear up for their final task to decide who the baby would be handed over to. Anita and Dibakar explain the rules. Meanwhile, the girls plot to win by diverting the boys’ attention. Who will win the task?

videos.title: The Final Round Starts
videos.overview: In the final task, the girls try to divert the boys’ attention, and hide the doll basket from the boys. Meanwhile, Adhiraj and Mayank fool Suhani and Nupur with duplicate baskets. However, Gunjan learns about Adhiraj’s ploy. Who will win the final task?

videos.title: The Gang Gets Surprised
videos.overview: Tanya and Dibakar tell everyone that they have received the DNA test results and everyone is eager to know the names of the real parents of the baby. Tanya and Dibakar reveal the names and the gang gets surprised. Who are the real parents?

videos.title: Uday Taunts Nupur
videos.overview: Samrat is surprised when he comes to know that Gunjan had trusted him blindly. Adhiraj gets sad when Suhani tells him that she is going to London to meet her mother. Mayank is angry with Uday as he taunts Nupur about the Holi incident. Will Nupur and Mayank be able to clear the misunderstanding?

videos.title: Nupur and Mayank Grow Close
videos.overview: Adhiraj is upset with Suhani’s decision and plans to break up with her as he believes that the long distance relationship between them will not work. Nupur and Mayank grow close. The boys try to console Adhiraj. Suhani is shattered by Adhiraj’s decision. Will the gang let this happen? Will they be able to solve the issue?

videos.title: Samrat Tries to Stop Suhani
videos.overview: Samrat pretends to be sad as he wants Suhani to miss the flight. The police officer stops Mayank, Adhiraj and Benji and suspects them to be diamonds thieves and they get shocked when Mayank agrees to show the hidden diamonds to the police. Will they be able to stop Suhani from going to London?

videos.title: Mayank Is Pranked
videos.overview: The girls plan to play a prank on Mayank and Nupur send a tiffin box for him with a time bomb. The police find the bomb and everyone realises that the bomb is fake. The police warn Mayank against making hoax calls to the police. Mayank plans to take revenge on Nupur. Will he succeed in his plan?

videos.title: Investigation on Uday's Murder
videos.overview: Samrat gets a call that Uday has met with an accident. The girls become emotional on hearing this.  A police officer tells the gang that Uday is murdered and he suspects the murderer to be from among his friends. Is there any the truth behind the officer’s suspicion?

videos.title: Gunjan Is Excited
videos.overview: Everyone mourns Uday’s death but they know that he is alive. Mayank and Samrat hatch a plan to force Uday himself to disclose the truth in front of everyone. Gunjan is excited to know that the famous director Neil Oberoi is visiting Excel college. Why is Neil coming to Excel? Will Uday reveal the truth to all?

videos.title: Neil Oberoi Meets Gunjan
videos.overview: Gunjan is happy about Neil’s visit and wants Nupur to give the auditions. The gang does not trust Gunjan when she tells them about the auditions. Neil is irritated waiting for Gunjan and asks his team to pack up. Gunjan requests him to give Nupur a chance. Will Neil take Nupur’s audition?

videos.title: Nupur Prepares for the Audition
videos.overview: Neil agrees to take Nupur’s audition but wants Gunjan to give the audition too. Gunjan agrees to fulfil Nupur’s wish. Nupur rehearses for the audition with Mayank and Benji. Mayank thinks that Nupur is not well and tries to stop her from giving the audition. Will Nupur be able to give the audition?

videos.title: Nupur Hallucinates
videos.overview: The doctor tells Mayank that Nupur is hallucinating. Neil insists that Gunjan enact a breakup scene with Samrat. She is worried that the scene might become true in real life, but finally goes through with it. Gunjan’s performance is appreciated and she is offered a lead role in Neil’s film. Will she accept it?

videos.title: Samrat Supports Gunjan
videos.overview: Nupur gets excited to know about Gunjan’s selection for the lead role and convinces her to accept it. Neil insists that the gang to convince Gunjan. Samrat tells the gang that he is with Gunjan in her decision. Will Gunjan accept the role? Will Neil be able to cast Gunjan in his film?

videos.title: Mayank Consoles Nupur
videos.overview: The gang is happy to know that Gunjan has accepted the role in the film. Mayank consoles Nupur when he notices her disappointment on not being selected. Samrat hugs Gunjan when he finds her nervous before the shooting and thinks that she might leave him after becoming famous. Will Gunjan be able to act?

videos.title: Samrat Encourages Gunjan
videos.overview: Samrat encourages Gunjan to go for the shoot. Diya and Nupur interrupt the shooting which annoys Neil and he gives Gunjan a break to improve concentration. Neil asks Gunjan to perform well as Nissar Khan is ready for the shot. Will Gunjan be able to perform? How will Neil deal with the situation?

videos.title: Nupur Confess to Samrat
videos.overview: Nupur comes to know about the new scholarship and job opportunity. She considers taking it up as she wants to support Mayank financially. Neil gets angry with Gunjan as she is forgetting her dialogues during the shoot. Gunjan tells Samrat that she does not want to act. Will he be able to convince her to act?

videos.title: Samrat Throws a Party
videos.overview: Neil pacifies Gunjan, when she confronts him and asks her not to run away from her commitments. He persuades her to accompany him to the press conference. Samrat throws a party for Gunjan and plans to sing a song for her at the party. Will Gunjan be able to attend the party?

videos.title: Gunjan Apologises to Samrat
videos.overview: Gunjan is shocked to know about the party from Diya and apologises to Samrat for her absence. Samrat feels insecure seeing Neil and Gunjan together. Nupur wants to do something big in life so that she can become independent. Will Nupur be able to achieve her dreams?

videos.title: Nupur Takes an Interview
videos.overview: Mayank is surprised when Nupur does not trouble him at home. Nupur takes an interview of a candidate for the scholarship selection. Diya gets angry with Benji as he goes to the party without her. Gunjan tells Neil that she is missing Samrat and calls him. Will they be able to talk to each other?

videos.title: Neil Searches for Samrat
videos.overview: Neil is dumbfounded when Gunjan confesses her love for Samrat. He agrees to help her search for Samrat. Later, on finding Samrat in the college canteen, Gunjan hugs him, shocking Neil. Will Neil profess his love for Gunjan? Meanwhile, Mayank is irritated when Nupur talks about their children.

videos.title: Uday Reads Out an Article
videos.overview: Gunjan meets Samrat and tells him that she was worried about him. Neil gets upset seeing Samrat and Gunjan hugging each other. Mayank prepares for the second round of scholarship. Uday reads out an article about Gunjan in the newspaper which makes Samrat angry. What is the content of the article?

videos.title: Benji Is Happy
videos.overview: Benji is pleased about his movie date with Diya.  Mayank suspects that Nupur is planning to extend their family. Samrat asks Neil to stop gossip stories about Gunjan in the press. Neil feels these rumours are best ignored. Gunjan agrees.

videos.title: Samrat Slaps a Reporter
videos.overview: Samrat slaps a reporter when he asks Gunjan about her relationship with Neil. The reporter threatens to file a FIR against them. Mayank, who wants to concentrate on the scholarship test, is reluctant to become a father now. How will Nupur react and what happens to her scholarship test?

videos.title: Gunjan Is Upset
videos.overview: Nupur clears her scholarship test. However, Mayank does not get shortlisted. Samrat apologises to the news reporter but is angry with Gunjan. Neil tries to cheer Gunjan when he finds her upset because of Samrat. Will Gunjan be able to pacify Samrat?

videos.title: Mayank Hurts Nupur
videos.overview: Mayank blames Nupur for his failure, upsetting her. She leaves for Delhi on some official work. Samrat decides to sort out the problem with Gunjan, but Neil’s men do not allow him to meet her. How will Samrat tackle this problem?

videos.title: Samrat Is Angry With Gunjan
videos.overview: Samrat is angry with Gunjan as she favours Neil and insists on finishing the film. Neil tells Gunjan to quit the film if her profession is ruining her personal life, but she turns down his idea. Mayank is upset about Nupur’s financial independence. Will both the couples sort out their differences?

videos.title: Nupur Decides to Be Independent
videos.overview: Nupur decides to complete her scholarship to have an independent identity. Neil advises Samrat to handle his relationships maturely, which makes him angry. Gunjan writes a letter to Samrat and asks Diya to give it to him. Samrat rushes to meet her after reading the letter. What was letter about?

videos.title: Neil Confesses to Samrat
videos.overview: Neil reveals to Samrat that he loves Gunjan. Samrat discloses Neil’s confession to the boys. Mayank tells him that Neil has an opportunity to get close to Gunjan during their outdoor shoot. A reporter agrees to reveal the location of the shoot to Samrat but on a condition. Will Samrat accept the condition?

videos.title: Neil Talks to Gunjan
videos.overview: Samrat asks Mayank to clarify everything with Nupur but he refuses to do so. Neil tells Gunjan that she can reveal the shooting location to Samrat after the shoot is over. Samrat shares his love story with the reporter. Will Samrat find out the location?

videos.title: Neil's Promise
videos.overview: Mayank informs the gang about his MBA scholarship in America. Later, he feels guilty for hurting Nupur and plans to apologise to her. Neil decides to make things fine between Gunjan and Samrat. Meanwhile, Samrat reaches the shooting location and is shocked to see Gunjan crying.

videos.title: Samrat Tells the Truth
videos.overview: Mayank tries to trace Nupur’s address in Delhi. He also dedicates a song for her on a radio show. Gunjan is hurt to see her love story published in a newspaper. She also learns about the shooting being stopped. Samrat tells the truth to Gunjan and promises to set things right. Will he succeed?

videos.title: Neil's Challenge to Samrat
videos.overview: Mayank advises Samrat to get the shooting back on track. Gunjan is angry with Samrat and is shocked to learn that Neil is in love with her. Neil agrees to forgive Samrat, but asks him to arrange Rs 5 crore in a day so that they can resume shooting. Will Samrat arrange for the money?

videos.title: Samrat Pays Neil the Money
videos.overview: Samrat gives Neil a cheque of Rs 5 crore and requests him not to tell Gunjan that he took the money from his mother. Neil asks Gunjan to forgive Samrat and informs her about resuming the shoot. Meanwhile, Mayank requests Nupur to return. Will she listen to Mayank?

videos.title: Gunjan Apologises to Samrat
videos.overview: Mayank meets Nupur and requests her to return home, but she refuses. Neil tells Gunjan that Samrat has helped him financially to start the shoot again. Gunjan apologises to Samrat and he asks her not to back out of the film. Will Gunjan continue to work in the film?

videos.title: Will Gunjan Say Yes?
videos.overview: Mayank is shocked to see the divorce papers and walks out of the house. He saves Nupur from falling off the terrace and they spend some time together. Will they iron out their differences? In the meantime, Samrat proposes marriage to Gunjan. Will Gunjan accept?

videos.title: Samrat and Gunjan Reunite
videos.overview: Samrat and Gunjan confess their love for each other. Mayank and Nupur also sort out their differences and promise to keep their relationship intact. Nupur is delighted when Mayank agrees to extend their family.

videos.title: Nupur Is Happy for Mayank
videos.overview: Mayank informs Nupur about his MBA scholarship in the US, but she refuses to accompany him as she wants to focus on her own scholarship. Gunjan and Mayank inform the gang about the recent developments in their respective relationships. How will the gang react?

videos.title: Samrat Gets His Ring Back
videos.overview: Samrat is upset as his chosen engagement ring is sold to someone else. Benji finds the customer who bought the ring and Nupur manages to get it back. Later, Nupur teases Gunjan by telling her that Samrat is seeing someone else. Neil is upset when Gunjan discontinues his film, but gives her Samrat's cheque.

videos.title: Nupur Is Excited
videos.overview: The gang surprises Samrat and Gunjan by throwing them an engagement party. Mayank announces that he and Nupur will go to the US together. Nupur is excited, but also sad to leave Gunjan behind. Samrat tells Mayank he will miss him. But will they notice the petrol leaking from the car?

videos.title: Samrat and Gunjan's Engagement
videos.overview: While Mayank and Nupur gear up to leave for the US, the gang arranges to celebrate Samrat and Gunjan’s engagement. Nupur expresses her sadness of leaving Gunjan in Mumbai. Meanwhile, Samrat and Mayank recall the time they spent together. Will their friendship last forever?

videos.title: A Terrible Accident
videos.overview: Gunjan is sad about Mayank and Nupur leaving. All four friends want to reach the airport on time, and Samrat is drives rashly. The car's brakes fail and all four of them get seriously injured in a terrible accident. What will happen to Mayank and Nupur now?

videos.title: Mayank Recalls the Accident
videos.overview: Mayank recalls the accident during a test drive of his new car technology. Later, he prepares to leave for India. Meanwhile, Ash is impressed with Samrat's bike riding skills as he gets ready for the race. While the students mourn the tragic accident, Rohan plays a prank on them, which upsets Samrat.

videos.title: Ash Searches Samrat
videos.overview: Rohan is upset to see Ash looking for Samrat in college. Mayank and Samrat meet. Mayank blames him for the accident and slaps him. Later, Gunjan stops Samrat from committing suicide. Mayank remembers old times and the terrible accident. Will Mayank forgive Samrat?

videos.title: Ash Meets Samrat
videos.overview: Ash comes to Excel College to meet Samrat, but ends up returning Rohan's watch. Samrat's mother wants Shukla to hire Mayank as a professor, but Mayank refuses when he learns that Samrat is a trustee. Mayank cries during the pooja to observe Nupur's death anniversary.

videos.title: Nirbhay Joins Excel College
videos.overview: Rohan's sister Riya wants to join Excel College. Indira asks Samrat to make sure that Riya joins because of the donation money she will bring. Meanwhile, a new student named Nirbhay stops some pranksters. Samrat then tells his mother that he will give the last seat to Nirbhay instead of Riya.

videos.title: Mayank Remembers His Past
videos.overview: Riya joins Excel College. Rohan is protective of her and she gets irritated. Riya and Nirbhay fight with each other, reminding Mayank of his time with Nupur. Riya and Nirbhay have the same roll number, and Mayank asks Rohan to sort this out in the admin office. Samrat and Gunjan miss the time they spent together.

videos.title: Mayank Recalls Nupur's Death
videos.overview: Gunjan is forced to sing by an orphan. Meanwhile, Samrat is upset with Ash for pestering him. Rohan saves Ash from some bad guys, but she refuses to thank him. Mayank and Gunjan think about Nupur's death. Meanwhile, Mayank offers Nirbhay a place to stay.

videos.title: The Competition Begins
videos.overview: Samrat blames himself for Nupur's death. He thinks of how all his friends left him after the accident and feels guilty. Nirbhay and Riya get ready to compete for the last seat. Samrat is late to judge the competition and Mayank taunts him. Who will win the competition?

videos.title: Nirbhay Is Challenged
videos.overview: Ashwini meets Gunjan and seeks her advice. Gunjan urges her to forget the past. Mayank accuses Samrat of twisting the competition to help Riya win. Meanwhile, Rohan challenges Nirbhay to a boxing match. Samrat apologises to Ash for being rude. Later, he learns that Mayank's life is in danger.

videos.title: Gunjan Rejects Samrat
videos.overview: Mayank tells Gunjan that he feels it's time to forgive Samrat. While missing the time spent with Gunjan, Samrat approaches her. But she tells him that she stopped loving him after Nupur's death. Samrat is shocked. Meanwhile, Rohan and Nirbhay's boxing match begins.

videos.title: Mayank Is Upset With Rohan
videos.overview: Nirbhay hates sharing his table with Riya. Mayank scolds Rohan and Nirbhay for keeping a boxing match, which makes both Riya and Rohan angry. A drunk Samrat faints and Ash helps him. Gunjan comes to meet Ash and suspects her of drinking with her friends. Will she see Samrat?

videos.title: Mayank Learns the Truth
videos.overview: Ash doesn't tell Gunjan about Samrat, and stops her from entering her room. Mayank catches Rohan kissing a girl in college and warns him. Mayank learns that Samrat is in Ash's home and rushes to meet him. Samrat tells him that Gunjan ended their relationship.

videos.title: Samrat Seeks Mayank's Help
videos.overview: Samrat seeks Mayank's help in reuniting him with Gunjan, but he refuses. Riya shocks Mayank by saying she doesn't want to study, and he insults her. Mayank and Samrat ask Shukla to decide between Riya and Nirbhay. Riya accuses Mayank of flirting with her, but Samrat defends him and doesn't let Riya leave.

videos.title: Samrat Defends Mayank
videos.overview: Samrat defends Mayank. He later apologises to Ash and meets her in a café. Mayank also meets Gunjan in the same café, but Samrat and Gunjan don't see each other. Samrat warns Riya of playing tricks and causing trouble. He asks her to apologise to Mayank.

videos.title: Riya Apologises to Mayank
videos.overview: Ash joins Excel College. Riya apologises to Mayank, who sees that other students are avoiding Riya. An upset Ash tells Samrat how she became an orphan. He consoles her, but refuses to share anything about his past. Ash wants to introduce Samrat to Gunjan. How will they react?

videos.title: Gunjan Comes to Excel
videos.overview: Riya is irritated when Rohan favours Mayank. Gunjan cries when she recalls her college days. Samrat sees her in college, but can't talk to her. He visits Ash's home and suspects that Gunjan is there. He praises Gunjan and tells Ash about their relationship. Mayank and Gunjan plan to celebrate Nupur's birthday.

videos.title: Rohan Flirts With Ash
videos.overview: Mayank thanks Gunjan for consoling him, and she asks him to look after Ash in college. Rohan goes to Ash's house. Gunjan thinks he is Ash's boyfriend, and gets upset. While Rohan flirts with Ash and irritates her, Mayank is surprised to learn that Samrat knows Nupur's birthday.

videos.title: Samrat Is Frustrated
videos.overview: On Nupur's birthday, Gunjan bakes a cake and gives Mayank the letters that Nupur wrote to him, but never sent. Both of them miss Nupur and cry a lot. Meanwhile, why is Samrat frustrated?

videos.title: Rohan and Ash Become Friends
videos.overview: Mayank asks Riya to catalogue all 17,000 books in the college library, and tells her to begin immediately. Rohan pretends to be Ash's boyfriend in front of Gunjan, but later agrees to be her friend. Samrat hides Gunjan's orange dupatta and Ash sees him doing this.

videos.title: Ash Tries to Impress Samrat
videos.overview: Samrat refuses to move on and forget Gunjan. He confesses his strong feelings for Gunjan to Mayank. Later, he is surprised to see Ash in ethnic clothes, while Rohan admires her new look. But Ash is upset that she could not impress Samrat. Meanwhile, an irritated Riya tells Mayank that she hates Excel College.

videos.title: Samrat Wants Gunjan Back
videos.overview: Samrat refuses to allow a fresher's party as requested by Mayank. Gunjan catches Rohan sneaking into Ash's house. Samrat wants Gunjan back in his life and goes to meet her, but Ash refuses to let him in. Later, he hears Gunjan recalling past memories and is happy that she still loves him.

videos.title: Samrat's Promise
videos.overview: When Samrat learns Gunjan doesn't want him in her life, he vows to make her happy again. Rohan gifts Ash a friendship band. Ash is upset to see Samrat coming from her house. But Samrat is busy dreaming about Gunjan's happiness. Will Mayank help him?

videos.title: Samrat Shares His Idea
videos.overview: Samrat shares his idea of a Freshers Party and decides to make Gunjan visit Excel College. He asks Rohan to convince Ash to bring Gunjan along. While Rohan fails to convince Gunjan to accompany him to the party, Riya requests Mayank to take her shoppng. Will Ash be able to convince Gunjan to come?

videos.title: Gunjan Comes to the Party
videos.overview: Ash asks Gunjan to come to the party, but Gunjan says she will ask Mayank. Later, Gunjan learns that Rohan is not Ash's boyfriend and decides to attend the party to know who he really is. As she reaches the party, Gunjan remembers the time spent with Samrat and Nupur.

videos.title: Gunjan Dances at the Party
videos.overview: Even as Mayank refuses to attend the party, Samrat vows to win back his friendship. Riya is upset when Mayank doesn't come. Samrat gives Rohan tips to impress Ash. Later, Ash asks Rohan to dance with her. Gunjan, Ash, Samrat and Rohan wear masks and dance at the party.

videos.title: Ash Is Angry With Gunjan
videos.overview: Gunjan is upset when she meets Samrat at the party and asks him to stay away. Mayank dislikes Riya's work in the library, which makes her cry. Gunjan keeps asking Ash about her mystery boyfriend, but Ash gets angry and asks her to stay away from personal matters. What will Gunjan do now?

videos.title: Gunjan Joins Excel
videos.overview: Gunjan takes Mayank's help to find out about Ash's boyfriend. On his insistence, she agrees to take the counsellor’s job in Excel College. Samrat is very happy to hear this and asks Shukla not to tell Gunjan that he is a college trustee. Ash is very angry to learn that Gunjan is joining Excel.

videos.title: Samrat Pretends to Be Unhappy
videos.overview: Mayank avoids Riya in the college. In front of Mayank, Samrat pretends to be unhappy about Gunjan's joining. Later, Samrat disguises himself and takes Gunjan's interview. Mayank suspects something, but Riya and Shukla don't let him enter Samrat's cabin. Will Gunjan learn the truth?

videos.title: Samrat Pretends to Be Mr Chaddha
videos.overview: Samrat pretends to be Samarjeet Chaddha and tells Mayank that he is a new trustee. While Mayank gets suspicious, Samrat takes Rohan and Riya's help in welcoming Gunjan to Excel by giving her red roses. Later, Riya tells Mayank that she expects him to give her red roses, which makes him angry.

videos.title: Samrat Advice's Rohan to Go Slow
videos.overview: Rohan wants to give Ash a red rose, but Samrat stops him and advises him to take it slow. Samarjeet admires Gunjan's teaching and shares his lunch with her. He is happy to see Gunjan enjoying herself.

videos.title: Mayank Is Surprised
videos.overview: Mayank is surprised when he sees Gunjan favouring Samarjeet. He learns of Samarjeet's true identity and questions Samrat, who asks him for a chance to win Gunjan's heart. While Samrat is happy that Gunjan likes Samarjeet, Ash realises that Samrat is the author of Rohan's poem for her.

videos.title: Fun Events in Excel
videos.overview: Gunjan's team wins the treasure hunt organized by Samarjeet. Later, Mayank questions Samrat about his intentions behind organising a college picnic. Gunjan recalls the accident when Samarjeet asks her to sit in his car for the picnic. Meanwhile, Riya tries to get close to Mayank.

videos.title: Mayank Is Furious
videos.overview: Riya's rash driving infuriates Mayank. Heavy rain forces everyone into a bungalow, where Samrat starts a truth or dare game. Ash chooses truth and Rohan asks her to describe her ideal person. Later, Gunjan asks Samarjeet to choose dare, and he removes his disguise.

videos.title: Mayank Tells the Truth to Gunjan
videos.overview: Gunjan is furious with Samrat for cheating her and he apologises. When Mayank tells her that Samrat is a trustee, she decides to resign from Excel. Ash, Rohan and Riya try to convince Gunjan not to resign, and Samrat drags her into a classroom.

videos.title: Samrat, Gunjan Share a Moment
videos.overview: Samrat tries to get close to Gunjan but she tells him she hates him. He kisses her and tells her he knows her true feelings. Mayank accepts Shukla's challenge of not letting Gunjan quit. Gunjan tells Mayank she is upset with Samrat for showing her that she still loves him.

videos.title: Mayank Begins the Audition
videos.overview: Mayank realizes that Samrat really loves Gunjan. Samrat announces the college's Annual Day, and also Gunjan's resignation, which makes her very upset. He also pretends to ignore her in front of students. Gunjan decides not to resign and move on in life. Mayank begins the auditions for Annual Day.

videos.title: Samrat Wants to Direct the Play
videos.overview: Gunjan selects Devdas as the story of her play. Samrat insists that Gunjan let him be the director and she agrees. While Ash calls Gunjan old and boring, Rohan's auditions for the play don't go well. Samrat plays the role of Devdas and impresses everyone with his acting. Will his words of love melt Gunjan's heart?

videos.title: Mayank Misses Nupur
videos.overview: Mayank asks Gunjan and Samrat to enact Paro and Devdas to help Rohan. Samrat insists Mayank should play the role. Mayank starts to cry while enacting Devdas as he misses Nupur. He later tells Smarat and Rohan that Gunjan should play Paro's role.

videos.title: Gunjan to Sing a Song in the Play
videos.overview: Gunjan hesitantly agrees to sing a song in the play. Mayank is shocked to learn that someone collected Nupur's certificate. Diya tells Mayank about a person in China, who spoke to her about Nupur. She also tells him that she often sees Nupur in her dreams, but he doesn't believe her.

videos.title: Mayank Is Shocked
videos.overview: Samrat and Gunjan are excited to meet Diya as she is a famous designer. Diya doesn't know about their breakup. While Ash helps Rohan tie a dhoti, Diya helps Gunjan realise Samrat was not responsible for the accident. Later, someone calls out Nupur's name and shocks Mayank. Is Nupur alive?

videos.title: Diya Confuses Mayank
videos.overview: Diya is not sure that Nupur is dead and Mayank is shocked. They visit the hospital to get Nupur's death certificate, but the attendant refuses. Later, Mayank finds some errors in the certificate and asks Dr Tripathy to check. Meanwhile, Rohan tells Ash he loves her.

videos.title: Mayank Is Shocked With the News
videos.overview: Samrat and Gunjan get close during the making of the play. Dr Tripathy tells Mayank that the death certificate belongs to another Nupur. Mayank is shcoked to learn that Nupur Bhushan may be alive. Diya asks Mayank to look for Nupur, but decides to keep this a secret from Samrat till they know for sure.

videos.title: Mayank Is Thrilled
videos.overview: Samrat and Gunjan are happy to be with each other, and both hope to be together again. Mayank is thrilled to know that his Nupur is still alive and was sent to a centre for recovery. But he learns that she has already been discharged and vows to find her.

videos.title: Play Rehearsals Begin
videos.overview: Mayank eagerly waits for Nupur to come back to him. Samrat likes the way Gunjan looks in Paro's dress. Gunjan dreams about Samrat giving her a rose. Samrat and Gunjan get closer when she has a wardrobe malfunction. But Gunjan really wants Mayank to play Devdas in the play.

videos.title: Gunjan Gets Emotional
videos.overview: Mayank refuses to take part in the play because he is busy looking for Nupur. He and Diya go to Nupur's address only to find that she moved out long ago. Meanwhile, Samrat decides to play Devdas's role and Gunjan gets emotional during rehearsal. Mayank wants to tell Samrat and Gunjan about Nupur.

videos.title: Mayank Searches for Nupur
videos.overview: Ash plays Chandramukhi's role in the play, making Gunjan think of her life as Devdas's story. Rohan keeps admiring Ash and forgets his dialogues. During the play, Paro (Gunjan) confesses her love for Devdas, and Samrat gets emotional. Mayank misses Nupur and continues his desperate search.

videos.title: Gunjan Pushes Samrat Away
videos.overview: Gunjan asks Samrat to stay away from her because she doesn't want to fall in love again. Samrat apologises for hurting her and agrees to stay away. Meanwhile, Mayank keeps feeling Nupur's presence around him. He tells Gunjan that Nupur is alive, which shocks her. Where is Nupur?

videos.title: Gunjan Argues With Samrat
videos.overview: Mayank is angry when Gunjan and Samrat refuse to believe that Nupur is alive. Gunjan argues with Samrat and Diya, and is sure Nupur is dead. But later, Diya, Samrat and Gunjan all help Mayank in hunting for Nupur. Gunjan worries about Mayank getting depressed. Later, Ash sees Gunjan hugging Samrat.

videos.title: Ash Reveals the Truth
videos.overview: Ash is shocked to learn about Gunjan and Samrat's love story from Rohan. She confesses her feelings for Samrat to Gunjan, who shares this with Samrat. Mayank traces Nupur's number and tries to call her. Later, he manages to find her, but she does not recognize him. What will Mayank do?

videos.title: Gunjan Doesn't Believe Mayank
videos.overview: Gunjan refuses to believe Mayank saw Nupur. When Mayank gets upset, Samrat asks Gunjan to be considerate of his feelings. She later apologises to Samrat for accusing him, and he forgives her. Rohan is upset about Ash's feelings for Samrat, but she thanks him for being there for her.

videos.title: Gunjan and Samrat Are Worried for Mayank
videos.overview: Gunjan thinks Mayank has become mentally unstable. An upset Mayank drives his car rashly and meets with an accident. Nupur sees him and takes him to the hospital. Mayank sees Nupur when he is conscious. Nupur tells the nurse that Mayank is her husband. How does Nupur remember now?

videos.title: Nupur Calls Gunjan
videos.overview: Doctors ask Nupur to call Mayank's family. Nupur calls Gunjan to tell her about the accident. Gunjan and Samrat don't meet Nupur because she's gone to buy medicines. When Nupur sees all of them in the hospital she decides to leave Mumbai. Gunjan and Samrat are shocked to learn that Nupur signed hospital forms.

videos.title: Samrat and Gunjan Chase Nupur
videos.overview: Gunjan now believes that Nupur is alive, and after Mayank is discharged they start searching for Nupur. Nupur calls the hospital to check on Mayank but disconnects before he can speak to her. Gunjan, Samrat and Mayank find that Nupur called them from Gurgaon, and rush there.

videos.title: Gunjan Sings in Gurgaon
videos.overview: At the Gurgaon bus stand, Mayank asks Gunjan to sing Nupur's favourite song so that she comes to them. Gunjan starts singing and soon Nupur finds them. Gunjan breaks down and hugs Nupur, but all are shocked that Nupur doesn't respond. Why is Nupur refusing to recognize them?

videos.title: Nupur Gets Angry
videos.overview: Nupur doesn't recognise Gunjan, Samrat and Mayank and is furious when she misses her bus. She refuses to accept Mayank as her husband. Their efforts to make her remember only make her more upset and she asks them to leave her alone. Does Nupur really have amnesia?

videos.title: Nupur Apologises to the Gang
videos.overview: Nupur goes to Mayank's house and apologises for her rude behaviour. She tells them that she teaches dance in Delhi's Shanti Ashram. Gunjan and Mayank ask her to spend a few days with Mayank to see if she can remember her past. Nupur refuses, but Mayank pretends to provoke her to get her to stay. Will she agree?

videos.title: Nupur Can't Remember Anything
videos.overview: Nupur finally agrees to spend a week with the gang. She gets upset when Gunjan insists that she's her sister. To help Nupur remember, Samrat, Mayank and Gunjan pretend to be college students. Gunjan then brings Nupur to the college.

videos.title: Nupur Warns Samrat
videos.overview: Gunjan fails to make Nupur remember their time together in college. Nupur doesn't like Samrat getting close to Gunjan and Mayank's presence also irritates her. The gang then locks her in the washroom and Mayank pretends to rescue her.

videos.title: Nupur Has to Do a Project
videos.overview: Nupur manages to avoid Mayank's questions about the talent parade. Shukla assigns the gang a project so that they can help Nupur remember. To their shock, Nupur selects Rohan instead of Mayank as her partner. Mayank pretends that he doesn't want to be Nupur's dance partner.

videos.title: Samrat Challenges Nupur
videos.overview: Samrat irritates Nupur by telling her that she doesn't know how to dance. Nupur and Mayank fight over the project in the library. Samrat locks them in the library. He then confesses his love to Gunjan and wants to take her out for dinner. But Gunjan and Samrat are also locked in the college.

videos.title: Nupur Performs in Front of Mayank
videos.overview: Nupur refuses to take water from Mayank, who tells her that she is rude and that he won't help her with the project. Nupur shows Mayank her dance and he pretends to hate it. Meanwhile, Gunjan and Samrat spend a romantic evening in the college.

videos.title: Samrat's Confession
videos.overview: Samrat tells Gunjan he missed her a lot. They spend more romantic moments together. Meanwhile, Mayank and Nupur fight about who tore up the statistics file while working on the project. Later, Gunjan returns Samrat's engagement ring and says that she will wear it after Nupur regains her memory.

videos.title: Nupur and Gunjan Bond
videos.overview: Gunjan tells Nupur about her and Samrat's engagement and the car accident. Later, Ash is introduced to Nupur, who then completes her project with her and Gunjan's help. Mayank is shocked when Rohan tells him about this. Nupur is also upset with Ash for spreading this news.

videos.title: Mayank Admits Defeat
videos.overview: Nupur taunts Mayank over the project, and he accepts defeat. Ash helps Nupur answer Saxena's questions about the project. Saxena wants Mayank and Nupur to participate in the college festival. Nupur and Mayank have to use Rohan's card in the library.

videos.title: Nupur Prepares a Dessert
videos.overview: Nupur asks Mayank to help her reunite Gunjan and Samrat, but he doesn't agree. Later, he joins in. Nupur surprises Gunjan by inviting Samraat for dinner. She also forces Ash to go to bed early. On the phone, Nupur promises someone that she will return home in 3 days.

videos.title: Samrat Is Locked Up
videos.overview: Gunjan falls asleep but is woken up by Nupur. Nupur accuses Ash of eating the dessert she had prepared for dinner. Mayank enters Nupur's room through the balcony. Nupur thinks it's Samrat and locks him up. Ash tells Gunjan that there might be thieves in the house. Gunjan is relieved and happy to see Samrat.

videos.title: Gunjan Tries to Stop Nupur
videos.overview: Gunjan and Samrat plan to bring Mayank and Nupur closer. Meanwhile, a phone call makes Nupur upset. Mayank confesses his love to her, but she gets upset and insists on leaving. Mayank gives up his efforts. Gunjan tries to stop Nupur from leaving Mumbai, but she refuses to listen.

videos.title: Gunjan Convinces Nupur
videos.overview: Gunjan manages to convince Nupur to stay for another day. Samrat and Gunjan notice that Nupur gets upset after talking on her phone. Gunjan gets a hold of her phone and receives the call. The gang is shocked to learn that the caller is Nupur's fiancé.

videos.title: Nupur Leaves the Gang
videos.overview: Mayank believes this is not his Nupur, but Gunjan disagrees. Nupur says goodbye, which makes Gunjan upset. But Nupur consoles her and asks Mayank if she can keep a group photo of the gang. Mayank goes to drop Nupur to the bus stop, where a truck is about to hit his car. Will there be another tragic accident?

videos.title: Nupur Realises Her Feelings
videos.overview: Mayank and Nupur take shelter in a garage as they get caught in the rain. Nupur asks Mayank to teach her salsa. As they dance, Nupur realises she has feelings for Mayank. They're both shocked to see Dhruv, Nupur's fiance, in the garage. Mayank feels bad when Dhruv expresses his love for Nupur.

videos.title: Nupur Leaves With Dhruv
videos.overview: Mayank tells the gang that Dhruv has taken Nupur back to Delhi. But they are surprised to see them in college. Dhruv takes the gang for lunch where he and Mayank debate about love. As they leave, Gunjan says she has seen Dhruv before. Later, Dhruv yells at Nupur and forbids her from meeting Mayank.

videos.title: Mayank Is Worried
videos.overview: Dhruv pretends to care about Nupur in front of Mayank, who is worried about Nupur. Dhuv hurts Nupur and threatens to kill Mayank. While Ash and Rohan tell Gunjan and Samrat about Dhruv’s behaviour, Nupur is shocked to learn that Mayank’s hand is bruised due to a short circuit at home.

videos.title: Dhruv Gets Violent
videos.overview: Dhruv blindfolds and traps Nupur in an empty classroom. He harasses her till she admits that she is Mayank's wife. Mayank sees Nupur hugging Dhruv, and returns the chain she left in the library. How will Dhruv react to this?

videos.title: Dhruv's Promise to Nupur
videos.overview: Dhruv injures his hand and is happy when Nupur looks after him. He promises to stay back and help unite Gunjan and Samrat. But he gets angry to see Nupur meet Mayank in the college. Mayank asks Nupur why she looks upset, but she pretends to be happy. Will Dhruv harasses her more?

videos.title: Dhruv Hits Nupur
videos.overview: Nupur urges Gunjan to wear her engagement ring. When Dhruv overhears Mayank telling Samrat that Nupur was crying, he slaps Nupur and accuses her of being unfaithful. Mayank intervenes and stops Dhruv from hitting her more. Will it turn into an ugly fight?

videos.title: Gunjan Learns the Truth
videos.overview: Gunjan is shocked on hearing about the fight and later remembers that Dhruv is Chintoo from Morena. Nupur asks Mayank to stay away from her, and wants Gunjan and Samrat to get married soon. Dhruv tries to hurt Gunjan, who escapes and confronts Nupur about the truth. Will Nupur break her silence?

videos.title: Who Is Dhruv?
videos.overview: Dhruv reveals his true identity to Nupur and is angry that she forgot him and married Mayank instead. He admits to causing the accident because he wanted Gunjan, Samrat and Mayank dead. Gunjan tells Mayank that Dhruv was mentally unstable and loved Nupur.

videos.title: Nupur's Request to Samrat
videos.overview: Samrat is happy that Nupur is alive, but she asks him to keep it a secret lest Dhruv harms Gunjan and Mayank. Gunjan and Mayank want to file a complaint against Dhruv but Samrat stops them. He seeks Rohan and Ash’s help in exposing Dhruv. Meanwhile, Nupur and Dhruv fight over decorations for a party.

videos.title: Dhruv's Challenge
videos.overview: Dhruv forces Nupur to celebrate their anniversary and gifts her bangles. Samrat tells Dhruv that he knows who Nupur really is, and that she loves Mayank. Dhruv says Nupur will never leave him. As part of his plan to free Nupur, Samrat tells Dhruv that Nupur is already married.

videos.title: Nupur Agrees to Marry Dhruv
videos.overview: Dhruv wants to marry Nupur on the same day and invites the gang. Mayank fights with Samrat for making it easier for Dhruv to force Nupur. Gunjan tells Nupur that she doesn't love her because she is marrying Dhruv. Samrat forces Mayank to save Nupur, and Mayank goes to meet her.

videos.title: Mayank Questions Nupur
videos.overview: Nupur doesn't reveal her true feelings to Mayank when he questions her. Meanwhile, Rohan destroys Dhruv's wedding attire. Meanwhile, Dhruv is angry that Mayank met Nupur. Mayank is about to burn the bridal dress but Nupur stops him and admits that she is his wife.

videos.title: Mayank, Nupur Are Happy
videos.overview: Nupur confesses her love for Mayank and tells him the truth. Dhruv is furious and threatens to kill the gang. He reveals how he tried to kill them in the accident. Ash records his confession and Dhruv is arrested. Mayank and Nupur are happy to be together. But why is Gunjan avoiding Samrat?

videos.title: Mayank and Samrat Bond
videos.overview: Nupur is back in Samrat's life but she is upset that Amba, the maid, knows more about Mayank's tastes and fires her. Mayank is angry that Nupur cooked non-veg food for him. Nupur feels Mayank has changed a lot and questions him. Samrat asks Gunjan for a dinner date but she refuses because of a board meeting.

videos.title: Nupur Is Angry With Mayank
videos.overview: Nupur is upset with Mayank, who promises to make it up to her. Samrat and Gunjan want to come to their house and Nupur gets upset because she wants quality time with Mayank. Mayank and Nupur lie to Gunjan to stop her from coming to their house, but Gunjan and Samrat come anyway.

videos.title: Gunjan,Samrat Suspect Mayank
videos.overview: Gunjan and Samrat think Mayank is having an affair with the maid. They break into Nupur's house and accidentally catch Mayank in the Jacuzzi. Meanwhile, Nupur wishes that she could join Excel as a teacher. Mayank misunderstands and enrolls Nupur as a student. How will she react?

videos.title: Nupur Shouts at Mayank
videos.overview: Samrat is fired when he refuses to go to Bahadurgunj. Mayank is angry that Nupur yelled at him in front of students. Gunjan questions Samrat about his resignation, but he doesn't tell her the truth. Meanwhile, Mayank treats Nupur as a regular student and does not give her a lift till college.

videos.title: Gunjan Enters Samrat's House
videos.overview: Samrat is not receiving Gunjan's calls so she decides to sneak into his house from the balcony. Nupur is upset when all the students tease her. Later, she cries when Rohan and Ash trick her and blacken her face. Mayank is scared that Nupur is angry with him for ignoring her.

videos.title: Gunjan Is Upset
videos.overview: Gunjan is upset as Samrat is not worried about losing his job. Samrat says he doesn't want to do MBA but wants to be a basketball player. Meanwhile, Mayank scolds Nupur for not being serious about her classes. Nupur gets more upset when he refuses to have lunch with her.

videos.title: Samrat Teaches Basketcall
videos.overview: After Rohan and Ash apologise to Nupur for making fun of her, she is happy and no longer angry with Mayank. Skeptical about doing an MBA, Samrat instead decides to coach the college basketball team. Mayank asks Nupur to take an oath of proper behaviour at home and in college. Will Nupur agree?

videos.title: Rohan,Ash's Group Study
videos.overview: Gunjan continues to force Samrat to do an MBA, but he is not interested. Mayank is annoyed on learning that Rohan and Ash have come home for group study. Nupur tells Rohan that women like strict men, and wants to use such tactics on Ash. Later, Nupur upsets Mayank by being late in class.

videos.title: Ash Joins Basketball
videos.overview: Samrat is nervous about the MBA mock test. He decides to become a basketball coach. Meanwhile, Rohan seeks Mayank's help in impressing Ash. Samrat is surprised when Ash comes to a basketball audition. Nupur is worried about the test as she is unprepared. Samrat then asks her to cheat.

videos.title: Nupur Plans to Cheat
videos.overview: Samrat requests the girls’ basketball team not to tell Gunjan that he's the coach. Gunjan sees his books in the dustbin but he avoids the situation. Nupur pretends to study and creates cheat notes. During the exam, Mayank is happy to see Nupur taking supplementary answer sheets.

videos.title: Nupur Is Proud of Herself
videos.overview: Nupur comes first in the class test and she is happy because she didn't cheat. Mayank congratulates her but later finds the cheat notes and confronts her. Samrat mistakes Gunjan for Ash and asks her to join him at home. Later, he has to lie to Gunjan when she hears a girl's voice in the background.

videos.title: Mayank's Suspicions
videos.overview: Nupur is happy when Mayank wants to meet her alone. But Mayank decides to throw her out of college because he suspects her of cheating and forging his sign on a letter that allows Ash to bunk his classes for basketball. Meanwhile, Gunjan notices a change in Samrat's behaviour.

videos.title: Gunjan to Console Nupur
videos.overview: Mayank asks Gunjan to console Nupur, who is angry that both of them don't trust her. Samrat feels bad about lying to Gunjan and shares this with Ash.
