Later, Gunjan and Mayank realise that they should not force their views on Nupur and Samrat. Will Nupur be able to prove her innocence?

videos.title: Samrat and Mayank Try Hard
videos.overview: Gunjan is upset that Samrat lied to her. Mayank tries to apologise to Nupur by decorating their home, but she refuses to forgive him. Samrat organises a candle-lit dinner for Gunjan, where she tells him she knows the truth about MBA and basketball. Samrat then tries his best to impress her.

videos.title: Saxena Defends Nupur
videos.overview: To Mayank's surprise, Saxena defends Nupur and insists she didn't cheat. Nupur is excited to re-join the college. She tells Gunjan that she supports Samrat's decision to play basketball. Later, Mayank uses Shukla to make Nupur see a notice about student body elections.

videos.title: Mayank Challenges Nupur!
videos.overview: Samrat makes a scene in the college by punishing himself. Nupur and Mayank decide to contest for the student body elections against each other. Rohan praises Samrat for his actions while Gunjan refuses to forgive him. Nupur informs Gunjan about the elections and seeks her help for the speech.

videos.title: Election Campaign Starts!
videos.overview: Gunjan comes to Nupur's aid and appeals the girls to vote for Nupur. Samrat motivates the boys to support Mayank. Nupur and Mayank fight when he calls to convince Gunjan to forgive Samrat. The duo strive hard to gain students support for votes. Nupur decides to throw a Navratri party for everyone.

videos.title: Nupur Gets Annoyed
videos.overview: Nupur gets annoyed with the students wishes for the party. She calls Rohan as his secret admirer to invite him for the superhero themed party aka dandiya party. Samrat and Mayank learn about the party and decide to go. Mayank realises that Nupur fooled them and challenges for a Dandiya competition.

videos.title: Nupur Reveals About Her Prank
videos.overview: The boys team and the girls team fight over who won the competition. Meawhile, Nupur accidentally utters that she pranked Rohan as his secret admirer. Both the teams end up having a cake fight. Uday disguises himself as a Gorilla and surprises everyone. He shares his troubles with them.

videos.title: Mayank and Nupur's Anniversary!
videos.overview: Mayank refuses to bend the rules for Uday when he requests the boys to get him a seat at Excel college. Rohan questions Uday about the stranger in a wheelchair at the hotel. Mayank becomes upset as Nupur forgot their anniversary. However, he gifts her a necklace and she expresses her love to him.

videos.title: Nupur's Victory!
videos.overview: Nupur requests Mayank to not talk to her at college because of the elections. Shukla sir insists Uday to announce the election results. Nupur asks Mayank to come to the store room to celebrate her victory. Mayank becomes shocked to see Uday's dead uncle in the wheelchair. Gunjan stops Nupur.

videos.title: Nupur Becomes Upset
videos.overview: Nupur becomes upset as Gunjan follows her to the store room. The girls find their uncle and questions the boys about him. Uday informs the boys about how his uncle died. Gunjan and Nupur reveal the secret to Shukla sir. Will the boys handle Uday's uncle and manage Nupur's questions?

videos.title: Gunjan Learns the Truth!
videos.overview: Nupur suspects Mr. Patel and insists Shukla sir to ask him questions in the classroom. She suspects something fishy within the boys gang. Gunjan overhears the conversation between Inspector Rathod and the boys, and learns the truth. Mayank reveals the truth to Gunjan and she becomes furious at him.

videos.title: Drama to Con Rathod!
videos.overview: The gang decides to con Inspector Rathod in order to get the lottery money and Gunjan supports them. Gunjan pretends to be Samrat's wife and she scolds him for taking advantage. Inspector Rathod questions everyone about the relations. Nupur joins the drama too and helps the gang.

videos.title: Mayank Lies to Rathod
videos.overview: Mayank lies to Rathod about losing his memory. Gunjan asks Nupur to pretend to be scared of Mayank to con Rathod. The gang worries as Mr.Patel's body is missing. Rathod gets locked in the store room and the gang lies that the door is jammed. Samrat doubts Rathod of hiding Mr. Patel's body.

videos.title: Mr.Patel Is Alive!
videos.overview: Samrat confesses his love to Gunjan. Rathod decides to give the lottery money to Mayank and Nupur and appreciates her for tolerating Mayank. Mr.Patel surprises everyone by talking to Rathod. Uday reveals that Mr. Patel was only unconscious. Mr.Patel reveals that he donated the money to a charity.
